editions.name: Standard Edition
editions.contents: The base game, which Rockstar calls a single-player experience. Every purchase made before 2026-11-20 includes the Vintage Vice City Pack, and digital pre-orders on PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store add one free month of GTA+. At retail it comes as a code in a box with no disc, on sale from 2026-11-12.

editions.name: Ultimate Edition
editions.contents: Everything in Standard, plus more than a dozen exclusive content drops that unlock through the story. These include premium vehicles such as a '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy, a '95 Grotti Cheetah, an army-style Dinka Enduro, a Crest kayak and a Shitzu Squalo boat, plus Vapid Ganado mods. It also adds his-and-hers revolvers and personalized pistols, extra mod shops, the Stock 305 clothing store, Electric Fang Tattoo with 50+ FAILE-designed tattoos, and a store-raid activity. It is reported to be digital-only at retail.

editions.name: Ultimate Edition Upgrade
editions.contents: An add-on that lets Standard Edition owners unlock the Ultimate Edition content later.

editions.name: The Goodtime State - Vice City Collection (collector's box, game not included)
editions.contents: 11 physical items, including a Macca the Gator figure, Oakley Frogskins sunglasses, a crossbody bag, a New Era 9FORTY cap, a shot glass, a keychain, a pin set, stickers and a double-sided Leonida map poster. Ships 2026-11-19 while supplies last.

intel.title: GTA VI is still dated November 19, 2026
intel.summary: As of late October 2026 there has been no third delay. Rockstar and Take-Two both list Thursday, Nov 19, 2026 as launch day on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
intel.body: The official site, Take-Two's August earnings release and the Oct 15 launch trailer all restate the date. Take-Two's fiscal 2027 bookings guidance depends on it, which investors read as a strong signal. Digital preload and the physical code-in-box release both start a week earlier, on Nov 12. Take-Two reports again on Nov 9, the last scheduled corporate checkpoint before launch.

intel.title: Two delays: Fall 2025, then May 2026, then November 2026
intel.summary: The game was revealed with a 2025 window and was delayed twice. Both times Rockstar said it needed more polish.
intel.body: Trailer 1 (Dec 2023) promised 2025, and Take-Two's February 2025 results still said Fall 2025. On May 2, 2025 the game moved to May 26, 2026. On Nov 6, 2025 it moved again to Nov 19, 2026. Both new dates still fall inside Take-Two's fiscal year 2027 (April 2026 to March 2027).

intel.title: First delay pushed GTA VI to May 26, 2026
intel.summary: On May 2, 2025 Rockstar moved the game out of Fall 2025 to May 26, 2026.
intel.body: Take-Two's press release the same day said Zelnick supported Rockstar taking extra time to realize its vision. It also said the company still expected record net bookings across fiscal 2026 and 2027. The move shifted the game into Take-Two's fiscal 2027. Trailer 2 followed four days later carrying the May 2026 date.

intel.title: Second delay set the November 19, 2026 date
intel.summary: On Nov 6, 2025 Rockstar posted on X that the game would slip about six months, apologizing and citing polish.
intel.body: The announcement came alongside Take-Two's fiscal Q2 2026 results, where Zelnick voiced confidence that Rockstar would deliver on the new date. On the investor call he said the aim was as near-perfect an experience as possible. He added that rivals who shipped unpolished games paid for it, and said he was highly confident in the new date. To The Game Business he said Take-Two believes in a date once it sets one.

intel.title: Launch platforms: PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only
intel.summary: GTA VI launches the same day on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. There are no last-gen versions.
intel.body: Every Take-Two release table since the reveal lists only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Sony's features page says it cannot be played on PS4. Rockstar's site carries a 'Plays Best On' PlayStation 5 badge from the Sony marketing partnership, but the Xbox version is not delayed. No Switch 2 or PC version is listed.

intel.title: Labeled PS5 Pro Enhanced, but no specs given
intel.summary: Sony's GTA VI page lists the game as PS5 Pro Enhanced. Neither Rockstar nor Sony has said what the Pro version improves.
intel.body: The PS5 Pro label appeared on PlayStation listings when pre-orders opened in June 2026. The joint PlayStation Blog post mentioned the Pro only as a hardware option. No resolution or frame-rate targets have been published. Outlets expect sharper image quality rather than a big frame-rate jump, but that is speculation.

intel.title: Report: 30fps on consoles, no 60fps promise
intel.summary: A creator at Rockstar's Edinburgh demo said Rockstar North's Rob Nelson described the game as running at 30fps for now, with no guarantee of a performance mode.
intel.body: Content creator Davy Jones made the claim on his podcast after a multi-hour demo. He said Nelson told guests he would need to check with the technical team about 60fps. Rockstar has not commented, and IBTimes UK could not verify the account. Digital Foundry pointed to CPU-heavy systems such as traffic, physics and crowd density as the likely limit. Rockstar's previous games also launched at 30fps on consoles.

intel.title: PC version reportedly targeted for Q1 2027
intel.summary: GamesBeat cites four anonymous industry insiders saying a PC release is planned for January to March 2027. Rockstar has not announced any PC version.
intel.body: Rockstar did not answer GamesBeat's request for comment, and official materials list consoles only. If accurate, it would be a much shorter gap than GTA V's, which reached PC about 18 months after consoles (Sept 2013 to April 2015). Rockstar leaders also spoke to Bloomberg in October, and coverage of that interview raised a possible PC version next year without confirming it.

intel.title: Price set at $79.99 Standard, $99.99 Ultimate
intel.summary: Rockstar announced US prices on June 24, 2026, the day before pre-orders opened. They are identical on PS5 and Xbox.
intel.body: The $79.99 base price is $10 above the common $69.99 current-gen price but below the rumored $100. The Ultimate Edition costs $20 more and adds story-threaded vehicles, weapons, apparel and activities. Standard owners can buy an Ultimate Edition Upgrade later. Outlets report UK and EU prices of £69.99 and €79.99 for Standard.

intel.title: What the Ultimate Edition adds
intel.summary: More than a dozen content drops unlock as you progress through Jason and Lucia's story. They include exclusive cars, a boat, weapons, shops and a store-raid activity.
intel.body: Vehicles include a '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy, a '95 Grotti Cheetah, an army-style Dinka Enduro, a Crest kayak and Vapid Ganado mods. Four of them come from a Classic Car Collection commission, and a Shitzu Squalo boat carries an explosives crate. Weapons include his-and-hers Hawk and Little Morgan revolvers and personalized Girardi and Klose pistols. It also unlocks the Rideout Customs and One-Eyed Willie's mod shops, the Stock 305 streetwear store, Sara's Unisex Salon and Electric Fang Tattoo (50+ FAILE designs). Rockstar's media page hosts 51 Ultimate Edition screenshots, and retail reports say this edition is digital-only.

intel.title: Pre-order bonus: the Vintage Vice City Pack
intel.summary: Every purchase made before Nov 20, 2026 includes a retro-themed bonus pack. Physical pre-orders get it while supplies last.
intel.body: The pack adds a two-tone '55 Vapid Stanier kept at the Shore Court Garage near Ocean Beach, which has a weapon locker and a drop-off for stolen goods. Jason gets a pastel linen suit and Lucia a red sequin dress with curls, plus a tropical pattern for most guns. Rockstar's media page has 12 screenshots of the pack.

intel.title: Digital pre-orders include a free month of GTA+
intel.summary: Pre-ordering any edition digitally on PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store includes one month of Rockstar's GTA+ subscription.
intel.body: The perks apply to the current GTA Online: a monthly GTA$500,000 deposit, bonus Shark Card value, vehicle discounts and the GTA+ Games Library. It renews at the paid rate unless cancelled. On PlayStation it must be claimed by March 31, 2027, it is limited to one per account, and it is unavailable in a few countries including China and Russia.

intel.title: Boxed copies hold a download code, not a disc
intel.summary: The retail version is a code in a box, on sale from Nov 12 so buyers can preload.
intel.body: Rockstar's pre-order announcement says the physical version contains a download code. On the August earnings call, Zelnick said Take-Two's business is well over 90% digital and that discs make little sense for very large games. He added that disc releases will still happen now and then. Earlier, in February 2026, he had denied that the physical version would launch later than digital.

intel.title: PS5 retail codes are region-locked
intel.summary: Rockstar's support FAQ says PS5 codes only redeem on PSN accounts in the same region. Xbox codes are not locked.
intel.body: Rockstar groups codes into North America, Europe, Japan, Asia, Latin America and Oceania. Because of local rules, Japanese PS5 codes expire 170 days after the Nov 19 launch. Buyers should purchase in their own account's region, since Sony does not let users change an existing PSN account's region.

intel.title: Preload opens November 12
intel.summary: Digital pre-orders can start downloading a week before launch, and the game unlocks on Nov 19.
intel.body: Sony's store lists a 7-day preload for both editions. Physical code-in-box copies go on sale Nov 12 for the same reason. Rockstar has not published an official install size. Guides estimate 150-200GB plus a day-one patch, but those are estimates, not confirmed figures.

intel.title: Install size not announced; 150-200GB is a guess
intel.summary: Rockstar has not published a file size. Widely shared 150-200GB figures are fan and outlet estimates.
intel.body: Guides suggest clearing about 250GB to allow for a possible day-one patch, compared with roughly 110GB for GTA V today. Leakers have claimed development builds exceed 200GB, and a viral 676GB figure came from a parody account. The exact number should appear on store listings around the Nov 12 preload.

intel.title: Rated M (Mature 17+) by the ESRB
intel.summary: The final ESRB rating, with seven content descriptors and an in-game purchases notice, appeared around Oct 1, 2026.
intel.body: The descriptors are Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Mature Humor, Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content, and Use of Drugs and Alcohol, the same set as GTA V. It first appeared on PlayStation Store and now shows on Rockstar's site. Australian and New Zealand store listings show R18+ and mention sex scenes. GTA BOOM reports PEGI 18, USK 18, CERO Z (about Oct 17) and Korea 19+, but a PEGI database search on Oct 26 found no GTA VI entry.

intel.title: Rumor: review codes are out, embargo lifts Nov 18
intel.summary: Leaker NateTheHate says outlets received review codes around Oct 26 and that reviews publish Nov 18, a day before launch.
intel.body: Rockstar has not confirmed the code rollout or an embargo date. Earlier forum chatter pointed to a Nov 18 midday-Europe embargo, possibly with some outlets waiting until launch. If accurate, critics would have a little over three weeks with the game.

intel.title: Sold as a single-player experience; no online mode announced
intel.summary: Rockstar's pre-order materials and the PlayStation Blog call GTA VI a single-player experience. No new GTA Online has been named or dated.
intel.body: Sony's features page lists the game as single-player with offline play. The pre-order announcement made no mention of multiplayer. Many outlets expect online to follow later, as GTA Online did two weeks after GTA V in 2013, but Rockstar has not said so. Any specific timeline, such as late 2026 or 2027, is speculation.

intel.title: Take-Two will keep supporting today's GTA Online
intel.summary: Zelnick told investors the current GTA Online will keep getting updates after GTA VI launches.
intel.body: On the August 2026 call he described GTA Online's update cadence as stable and said significant resources still go into it. The July 14 Quartz Center Heist update brought lapsed players back, and recurrent spending on the series grew 3% in the quarter. How a GTA VI online mode will relate to the GTA V version has not been explained.

intel.title: Debunked: physical copies arriving after launch
intel.summary: A January 2026 Polish report said there would be no physical release on day one. Zelnick replied that it was not the plan.
intel.body: PPE.pl had claimed physical copies would follow weeks later or in early 2027, supposedly to limit leaks. Take-Two later told IGN it was ruling out any format-based release gap, not just a 2027 slip. In the end the physical version is a code in a box that goes on sale Nov 12, before launch.

intel.title: Debunked: Best Buy's May pre-order date
intel.summary: A Best Buy affiliate email hinted at a May 18-21 pre-order campaign. Pre-orders actually opened June 25.
intel.body: On the May 21, 2026 call and in a Bloomberg interview, Zelnick said he did not know where the rumor came from. He said pre-orders would open alongside marketing, which would start once summer began in late June. That matched what happened.

intel.title: Trailer 1 broke YouTube and Guinness records
intel.summary: The December 2023 reveal drew more than 90 million YouTube views in 24 hours, a record for a non-music video.
intel.body: Rockstar posted it on the evening of Dec 4, 2023 after it leaked ahead of the planned Dec 5 debut. Guinness certified 90,421,491 views in 24 hours plus records for most-liked game trailer and most-viewed non-music video in a day. YouTube's own data showed 93M+. Tom Petty's 'Love Is a Long Road' scored it, and it passed about 255M views by May 2025.

intel.title: Trailer 2: Rockstar claims 475M views in a day
intel.summary: Rockstar says the May 6, 2025 trailer passed 475 million views across all platforms in 24 hours, calling it the biggest video launch ever.
intel.body: The count is Rockstar's own and covers every platform. Trailer 1 was YouTube-only, so the two are not directly comparable. For context, Deadpool & Wolverine's trailer had 365M first-day views. Trailer 2 was a surprise drop captured on PS5, split between gameplay and cutscenes, and Spotify saw a huge spike in streams of The Pointer Sisters' 'Hot Together'.

intel.title: Official site grew from a teaser into a full hub
intel.summary: rockstargames.com/VI added character bios with Trailer 2. In 2026 it gained Leonida, music, launch-trailer and media sections.
intel.body: The May 2025 update introduced profiles for Jason Duval, Lucia Caminos and supporting characters. The 'Only in Leonida' page now covers eight characters and six regions: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga. The media page lists 99 screenshots, 51 Ultimate Edition shots, 12 Vintage pack shots, 25 artworks and wallpapers, and 9 clips. Pre-order buttons and the ESRB badge were added in 2026.

intel.title: Sony co-markets GTA VI: 'Plays best on PS5'
intel.summary: A June 24, 2026 PlayStation Blog post, co-written by SIE marketing SVP Mary Yee and Rockstar, said the two worked closely to make PS5 the best place to play.
intel.body: Sony highlights DualSense haptics, adaptive triggers and the controller speaker, Tempest 3D audio and fast SSD loading. All official footage has been captured on PS5. Deal terms have not been disclosed, and the game is not a PlayStation exclusive. Reports say the Xbox-branded launch trailer went up eight days after Rockstar's, and no PS5 console bundle has been announced.

intel.title: Cover art revealed with the pre-order announcement
intel.summary: Rockstar released a cover art reveal video on June 24, 2026, the day it announced price and editions.
intel.body: The PlayStation Blog post that day pointed to the cover art video along with a dedicated PS5 features page. It was the first beat of the summer marketing campaign that Zelnick had promised in May. Game Informer later ran its own Rockstar-styled cover art of Jason and Lucia in a car for its September issue.

intel.title: First gameplay showcase premiered on Netflix
intel.summary: 'Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look' (26:48) debuted on Netflix on Aug 27, 2026 at 3 p.m. ET and hit YouTube six hours later.
intel.body: Announced Aug 6, it was Rockstar's first long-form look at real gameplay, all captured on a base PS5. It showed over-the-shoulder shooting and cover, switching between Jason and Lucia, robberies, police chases, nightlife, scuba diving, fan boats and street racing. Some outlets called it Trailer 3, but Rockstar used the Extended Look name. Press and creator previews from a hands-off demo at Rockstar North in Edinburgh were published around the reveal.

intel.title: Extended Look was Netflix's top title worldwide that week
intel.summary: Netflix counted 31.1 million views from Aug 24 to Aug 30. It was the No. 1 English-language film and topped the chart in 87 of 93 countries.
intel.body: That works out to about 14 million hours watched. Netflix counts a view as total hours divided by runtime, so the figure cannot be compared directly with YouTube plays. It was a strong showing for a 27-minute special but not a Netflix all-time debut record.

intel.title: Launch trailer arrives five weeks out
intel.summary: On Oct 15, 2026 Rockstar released a roughly 90-second launch trailer captured on PS5 and scored by Justice.
intel.body: It adds backstory for Jason, including trouble in the military and money problems, and is built around Jason and Lucia's relationship. It also shows action set pieces such as Lucia leaping from a car onto a moving plane. It reveals no new mechanics and reconfirms Nov 19. Rockstar has not released view counts, and fan tallies are unverified.

intel.title: Justice composes the original score
intel.summary: Rockstar named French electronic duo Justice as composers of GTA VI's original score and debuted their single with a star-studded feature lineup.
intel.body: 'Flower in a Hurricane' features Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard and soundtracks the launch trailer. Justice is Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay. The track also appears among the singles promoted for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.

intel.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, 34 original tracks
intel.summary: Announced in mid-September 2026, the album releases Nov 19 alongside the game, with pre-saves and vinyl/CD pre-orders open.
intel.body: The first singles came from Yung Lean (with Future and Metro Boomin), Travis Scott, CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso with PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Etienne de Crécy, Morgan Wallen, Rauw Alejandro and Keith Richards. Rockstar's music page later added Fuerza Regida, Cardi B and Justice. A $49.98 double-vinyl edition is scheduled to ship Nov 20.

intel.title: Six radio stations revealed
intel.summary: An Oct 8 Newswire post and Rockstar's music page introduced Leonida's in-game radio lineup.
intel.body: Named stations include Cocoteo (modern Latin), Back Country (country), Afro Bank FM (amapiano and African classics), The Chamber (metal), Flash FM (pop, billed as a Vice City institution) and Dirty South Classics (regional rap, hosted by Trick and Trina). Rockstar says the game has its biggest and broadest selection of radio and podcasts yet, including classic rock and talk stations.

intel.title: Two limited-edition GTA VI DualSense controllers
intel.summary: Revealed at the Sept 3, 2026 State of Play, the black (nightlife) and white (daytime) controllers cost $84.99 and release Nov 19.
intel.body: Both have a palm-tree motif, large VI numerals on the touchpad and a pearlescent purple center. Prices are $84.99, €84.99, £74.99 and ¥12,480. Pre-orders opened Sept 10 at 10 a.m. local time through PlayStation Direct where available.

intel.title: $400 Vice City Collection collector's box (no game)
intel.summary: On Sept 24, 2026 Rockstar opened orders for 'The Goodtime State - Vice City Collection', an 11-item box sold without the game.
intel.body: Contents include a Macca the Gator figure, Oakley Frogskins, a Leonida Keys crossbody bag, a New Era 9FORTY cap, a shot glass, a swizzle spoon, a keychain, an enamel pin set in a Vice City-styled tin, a sticker pack and a double-sided Leonida map poster. It ships Nov 19 while supplies last. It is a merchandise box, not a game edition.

intel.title: GTA VI merch collection hits the Rockstar Store
intel.summary: An Oct 8, 2026 Newswire post announced a Grand Theft Auto VI apparel and collectibles line on the Rockstar Store.
intel.body: The official site now links a dedicated GTA VI collection alongside the Vice City collector's box. It joins licensed items such as the DualSense controllers and the album's vinyl and CD editions as part of the pre-launch merchandising push.

intel.title: Game Informer cover story with 12 new screenshots
intel.summary: Game Informer's issue released Sept 29, 2026 carried a 14-page GTA VI cover feature with Rockstar interviews.
intel.body: The feature covered the advanced weather system, wildlife and Rockstar's research into Miami and Florida culture. It came with a dozen new screenshots. The cover shows Jason and Lucia in a car in Rockstar's illustrated style.

intel.title: 'Welcome to Vice City' sign tops Miami's arena
intel.summary: In late September 2026, crews installed giant pink 'Welcome to Vice City' letters on the roof of the Kaseya Center, home of the Miami Heat.
intel.body: The sign faces planes descending into Miami International and was reportedly lit around Oct 1. City commissioners let Rockstar pay for permits allowing oversized banners, with the permit money going to a trail in Overtown. CBS Miami said the exact agreement with the arena was unclear. Other outlets report a fee just under $1M and a run into 2027, but those figures were not checked here.

intel.title: Rockstar turns Miami into Vice City
intel.summary: By mid-October, GTA VI promotion covered South Florida, from a Goodyear blimp to beach chairs and arena takeovers.
intel.body: Reported placements include branded umbrellas and chairs on Miami Beach, banner planes, a convoy of in-game-style cars including a Vice City Police Lamborghini, and 'I love Vice City' buses. There are also ten Wynwood Walls murals, with free admission for Miami-Dade residents through 2028. The Miami Heat plans 'A Night in Vice City' on Nov 18, and Rockstar is sponsoring a free block party in Little Haiti on Nov 22.

intel.title: Hands-off press and creator demo at Rockstar North
intel.summary: Rockstar invited journalists and creators to Edinburgh for a multi-hour live demo led by Rockstar North's Rob Nelson. Accounts of it surfaced after the Extended Look premiered.
intel.body: Guests watched rather than played, so previews describe the look and systems rather than how the game handles. The session produced the widely circulated 30fps comment, which Rockstar has not addressed.

intel.title: Xbox's version of the launch trailer arrived eight days later
intel.summary: Reports say the Xbox Series X|S-branded launch trailer appeared on Oct 23, 2026, eight days after Rockstar's own release.
intel.body: Commentators read this, and TV spots reportedly missing the Xbox logo, as signs of a Sony marketing arrangement. Neither Sony nor Rockstar has confirmed terms. The game still launches the same day on both consoles.

intel.title: Take-Two guides record $8.0-8.2B in FY27 bookings
intel.summary: With fiscal 2026 results on May 21, 2026, Take-Two forecast record net bookings of $8.0-8.2B for FY27 and credited the Nov 19 launch.
intel.body: FY26 net bookings were $6.72B, up 19%, and GAAP revenue was $6.66B. FY27 guidance also calls for $7.9-8.1B in GAAP revenue and a return to net income. Take-Two reaffirmed the range on Aug 7. Zelnick has said FY27 should set a new baseline for the company.

intel.title: Q1 FY27: $1.39B in bookings, guidance held
intel.summary: Take-Two's Aug 7, 2026 results beat its own guidance, and it kept the full-year forecast ahead of GTA VI.
intel.body: Net bookings were $1.39B, down 3% year over year but above the $1.32-1.37B guidance. Recurrent consumer spending made up 84%. Q2 guidance is $1.62-1.67B. Pre-orders opened only five days before the quarter closed, so most GTA VI revenue will land in later quarters.

intel.title: Next Take-Two earnings: Monday, November 9
intel.summary: Take-Two will report fiscal Q2 2027 results after the market close on Nov 9, 2026, ten days before launch.
intel.body: The conference call is at 4:30 p.m. ET. It is the last scheduled investor update before GTA VI ships and the most likely place for any official pre-order or launch-readiness comments. As of Oct 26 nothing from that call exists yet.

intel.title: Zelnick: pre-orders are unprecedented
intel.summary: On the Aug 7, 2026 call, Zelnick called GTA VI pre-order demand 'unprecedented and astonishing' but shared no numbers.
intel.body: He said demand was so far beyond precedent that Take-Two cannot yet tell how it will turn into sales. He called the company cautiously optimistic and said it would not claim victory early. He warned that buying may be front-loaded and that cancellations are possible, which is why guidance was not raised.

intel.title: Pre-orders lean toward the $100 Ultimate Edition
intel.summary: In an Aug 10, 2026 CNBC interview, Zelnick said pre-orders were skewing toward the premium edition and beating expectations.
intel.body: He did not give an edition split or totals. The Ultimate Edition has consistently topped PlayStation Store pre-order charts. Notebookcheck notes it is not sold in retail cases, while Standard is available as a code in a box.

intel.title: Zelnick says Rockstar 'got it right' on price
intel.summary: Zelnick defended the $79.99 and $99.99 prices on the August call, arguing the game offers far more value than its cost.
intel.body: He said buyers can choose the edition that fits their budget. He also acknowledged that, given the hype, the company could have priced it differently. His long-running line is that Take-Two aims to deliver more value than it charges.

intel.title: Netflix deal billed as a first-of-its-kind partnership
intel.summary: Take-Two called the Netflix premiere of the Extended Look a groundbreaking partnership. Zelnick said Netflix acted as both marketing and distribution partner.
intel.body: Netflix had the video exclusively for six hours before it went to YouTube and other platforms. Zelnick declined to discuss terms or whether Netflix paid for the window. The Netflix tie-in follows Take-Two's earlier mobile ventures with the service.

intel.title: Zelnick in May: no delay, marketing starts with summer
intel.summary: At the May 21, 2026 earnings, Zelnick reaffirmed Nov 19 and said marketing would begin around late June, with pre-orders and price to follow.
intel.body: He told Bloomberg that summer technically starts at the end of June and that the campaign would not copy GTA V's playbook. He said Take-Two does not spend on marketing until close to release. To GamesBeat he would not celebrate the lack of a delay and noted there was still a long way to go. Price, pre-orders and the campaign all arrived June 24-25, as he had indicated.

intel.title: Feb 2026: strong quarter, date reaffirmed
intel.summary: Take-Two's Feb 3, 2026 results raised FY26 guidance again and kept GTA VI at Nov 19.
intel.body: Q3 FY26 net bookings rose 28% to $1.76B, and the FY26 outlook went up to $6.65-6.70B. Zelnick told IGN that committing to summer marketing showed confidence there would be no third delay. Take-Two also said GTA V had sold more than 225 million copies.

intel.title: Nov 2025: delay lands alongside raised guidance
intel.summary: Take-Two's fiscal Q2 2026 report (Nov 6, 2025) came the same day as the second delay. It still raised FY26 guidance.
intel.body: Net bookings rose 33% to $1.96B, and the FY26 outlook went up to $6.4-6.5B. The release table moved GTA VI to Nov 19, 2026, still within fiscal 2027. Zelnick said Take-Two expected record bookings in FY27.

intel.title: Zelnick: expect launch-day sick days
intel.summary: Speaking at the ESA's iicon event in Las Vegas in April 2026, Zelnick joked that many people would call in sick on Nov 19.
intel.body: The line went viral and has since been folded into speculative estimates of launch-day productivity losses. Zelnick gave no figure. It was a quip, not a forecast.

intel.title: Zelnick: crunch isn't how Take-Two works
intel.summary: In a Business Insider interview reported May 7, 2026, Zelnick said delays help avoid crunch, which he said is not part of how Take-Two operates today.
intel.body: He compared it to doing homework steadily instead of pulling all-nighters. He framed the two delays as a choice to give Rockstar time rather than push staff into overtime. Some reports linked the interview to an unverified online review alleging heavy overtime at a Rockstar QA team.

intel.title: Third-party estimate: about 6.45M digital pre-orders
intel.summary: Sensor Tower estimates put GTA VI at about 6.45M digital pre-orders worth about $630M by Oct 20, 2026, roughly three-quarters on PlayStation.
intel.body: The estimated split is about 4.8M on PS5 and 1.66M on Xbox. Earlier snapshots showed about 5.28M and $516M (data through Sept 8, 77% PlayStation) and about 6.08M and $594M in mid-October. These are modeled estimates, not Take-Two figures. Outlets disagree on whether they cover only the US, and GamingHQ flagged inconsistencies in the reported platform split.

intel.title: Analysts project multibillion-dollar first year
intel.summary: Outside forecasts expect GTA VI to gross several billion dollars in its first year. Take-Two has given no unit targets.
intel.body: In January 2025, DFC Intelligence projected more than $3B in first-year revenue, about $1B of it from pre-orders, and 100M copies within five years. Newzoo has been cited projecting up to $4.5B in launch-week spending. The only official benchmark is Take-Two's $8.0-8.2B FY27 bookings guidance for the whole company.

intel.title: Viral estimate: a $1B 'sick day'
intel.summary: Reports claim about 1.5 million US workers may skip work on launch day, costing about $1B in output. The math and sourcing are shaky.
intel.body: The figures trace to IBTimes coverage citing an economist and assume about $70,000 of yearly output per worker. Simple arithmetic with those inputs gives about $400M per day, not $1B. The 1.5M absence figure has no cited survey behind it. Treat it as a media talking point, not data.

intel.title: GTA V passes 230 million copies
intel.summary: Take-Two said GTA V had sold more than 225M copies by February 2026 and more than 230M by August 2026, giving GTA VI a huge installed fanbase.
intel.body: GTA V and GTA Online remain among Take-Two's top earners 13 years after launch. Take-Two said series recurrent spending grew 3% in its June 2026 quarter, helped by the Quartz Center Heist update.

intel.title: Rockstar first confirmed development in Feb 2022
intel.summary: On Feb 4, 2022, Rockstar confirmed for the first time that the next Grand Theft Auto was well underway.
intel.body: The note was tacked onto a GTA Online and GTA V next-gen update post and repeated on Twitter. It said Rockstar's goal is always to significantly surpass its previous work. No title, setting or date was given.

intel.title: 2022 hack leaked early GTA VI footage
intel.summary: In September 2022 a hacker posted dozens of early development clips. Rockstar confirmed the network intrusion on Sept 19, 2022.
intel.body: Rockstar said it was extremely disappointed but that development would continue as planned and live services would be unaffected. Take-Two filed takedowns to scrub the footage. In 2026 Rockstar leaders told Bloomberg the leak felt like a deep personal intrusion into the team's creative process.

intel.title: Rockstar adds a Sydney studio
intel.summary: In March 2025 Rockstar acquired Video Games Deluxe, its longtime port partner, and renamed it Rockstar Australia.
intel.body: The studio, founded by L.A. Noire's Brendan McNamara, had worked on L.A. Noire remasters and on updates to GTA: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition. Head of Publishing Jennifer Kolbe announced the deal.

intel.title: Rockstar fires 34 staff; union cries union-busting
intel.summary: On Oct 30, 2025 Rockstar dismissed 31 UK employees, all IWGB union members, plus 3 in Canada, citing gross misconduct over leaked confidential information.
intel.body: Rockstar says the staff shared confidential material in a Discord forum that included outsiders, and that union membership played no part. The IWGB calls it one of the most blatant union-busting acts in games. It says the firings followed the union passing the 10% membership threshold for statutory recognition. Industry observers say the timing near the second delay was coincidental.

intel.title: 220 Rockstar North staff demand reinstatement
intel.summary: In mid-November 2025, 220 current Rockstar North employees signed a letter to management condemning the firings.
intel.body: The letter asked for the 31 UK workers to be reinstated immediately. The IWGB organized protests at Take-Two's London and Paris offices and outside Rockstar North in Edinburgh on Nov 18, 2025. Rockstar maintained the dismissals were unrelated to union activity.

intel.title: UK Prime Minister weighs in on the firings
intel.summary: At Prime Minister's Questions in December 2025, Keir Starmer called the Rockstar dismissals deeply concerning and said ministers would look into them.
intel.body: He stressed every worker's right to join a union. The IWGB has also used the case to argue for stronger worker protections across the games industry.

intel.title: Tribunal pre-trial rulings split
intel.summary: In January 2026 the workers were denied interim relief. In June 2026 the tribunal refused Rockstar's bid to strike out the union's blacklisting claims.
intel.body: Interim relief, meaning continued pay pending trial, is rarely granted in the UK. The judge was not persuaded that union membership was likely the main reason for the dismissals. The June 17 ruling kept all union-busting and blacklisting allegations in play for the full hearing.

intel.title: Glasgow tribunal hearing held; verdict pending
intel.summary: The full employment tribunal ran from Sept 10, 2026 to about mid-October at the Glasgow Tribunals Centre. No decision had been reported as of Oct 26.
intel.body: The IWGB alleges Rockstar had a mole in its Discord from February 2024 and gave generic dismissal letters with no chance to respond. Rockstar argues the Discord was effectively public, with about 350 people in one channel, and that trust had irretrievably broken down. It cites three non-union Canadian staff fired for similar conduct. The workers seek reinstatement or compensation.

intel.title: Rockstar responds to the August 2026 gameplay leaks
intel.summary: About a week before the Netflix reveal, a persona called Cyberleek posted batches of real gameplay clips. On Aug 26 Rockstar called the leaks heartbreaking for its team.
intel.body: Rockstar's Instagram statement said this was not how it wanted fans to first see the game. It apologized for the long wait, said the game was nearly there, and asked players to avoid spoilers. Kotaku described the 15 clips as generic open-world footage without story content.

intel.title: Take-Two goes to court to unmask the leaker
intel.summary: On Aug 20, 2026 Take-Two filed DMCA subpoenas in the Southern District of New York seeking Microsoft and Discord records on the Cyberleek persona.
intel.body: The Microsoft request covers a GitHub repository and linked accounts. The Discord request seeks identifying data for members of named servers active since June 1, 2026. Take-Two later sought records from X, withdrew a YouTube subpoena, and on Aug 31 asked under seal for a second Discord subpoena. It called its investigation rapidly evolving, and no identification has been made public.

intel.title: Rockstar leaders open up to Bloomberg
intel.summary: In a mid-October 2026 Bloomberg Businessweek feature, Rockstar development heads Aaron Garbut and Phil Hooker discussed the 2022 leak and the studio's future pace.
intel.body: Garbut likened the 2022 leak to strangers rifling through the team's private laundry. Hooker said the engine, tools and team built for GTA VI should let Rockstar move faster, so the next game will not take eight years. Garbut said the foundational work is done and future projects will build on it rather than start over. No next project was named.

intel.title: Leonida: Rockstar's Florida
intel.summary: GTA VI takes place across the fictional state of Leonida, a satirical Florida centred on a modern Vice City.
intel.body: Rockstar's first press release placed the game in Leonida, home to Vice City and beyond. The official site calls Vice City the dark side of the sunniest place in America, and its story follows Jason and Lucia into a conspiracy that spans the state. Beyond the city, Rockstar has shown island chains, swamps, a decaying coast town, an industrial sugar town and a national park. Launch is November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

sources.name: Rockstar Games - Grand Theft Auto VI

intel.title: The six named regions
intel.summary: Alongside Trailer 2, Rockstar's site named Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.
intel.body: The May 6, 2025 site update gave each area a short write-up and a batch of screenshots. Vice City is the city of glamour and greed. The Keys are a laid-back island chain with risky waters. Grassrivers is untamed swamp, and Port Gellhorn a faded vacation town. Ambrosia is an industrial sugar town with bikers, and Mount Kalaga a park for hunting, fishing and off-roading. No newer top-level region has been officially added through late October 2026.

intel.title: Trailer 1 world highlights
intel.summary: Trailer 1 (released early on Dec 4, 2023 after a leak) opened in a prison and toured Vice City's beaches, the Keys, swamps and Florida-Man chaos.
intel.body: Rockstar posted the 90-second trailer a day ahead of schedule after a low-quality copy leaked. Locations fans have pinned include Lucia's cell in the Leonida Penitentiary, the Ocean Beach art deco strip, the bay and its causeways, the NINE1NINE club, a downtown highway near the arena, the Keys, airboats in Grassrivers, and Leonard County Sheriff cars near Waning Sands. The trailer closes on a Port Gellhorn store robbery. Wildlife moments include an alligator wandering into a convenience store.

intel.title: Trailer 2 and the screenshot drop
intel.summary: Trailer 2 (May 6, 2025) opened in the Leonida Keys, showed the prison gate, Ocean Beach hotels and bay islands, and arrived with a big screenshot drop.
intel.body: Community mapping ties Trailer 2's opening to Key Lento: Brian's marina and hangar, a pier and Jason's safehouse. Other scenes include the Grassrivers visitor centre, the penitentiary gate and towers, a bank vault, the Ocean View and Dominion hotels, and the Venetian-style islands at night. The accompanying screenshots revealed the Starlet Motel, Delights, the Allied Crystal refinery, VCIA signage and Watson Bay.

intel.title: The Netflix Extended Look (Aug 27, 2026)
intel.summary: A 26-minute PS5-captured gameplay showcase that debuted on Netflix for six hours before YouTube, and named new places.
intel.body: The broadcast introduced the Effluvia rooftop bar, Megamundo's TV-network tower and the Bayside waterfront in Vice City. It also showed swamps crossed by fan boat, manatees, snorkelling and scuba diving, gyms, racing, a shooting range, parachuting off rooftops, strip clubs and robberies of diners and small shops. Engadget's summary also notes a seaside port and at least one national park.

intel.title: Launch trailer (Oct 15, 2026)
intel.summary: Rockstar released a roughly 90-second PS5-captured launch trailer with no advance warning, mostly revisiting places from the Extended Look.
intel.body: Coverage notes it adds little story and shows a world already seen in August. Snakes appear among the wildlife. A fan breakdown says it opens in the Keys at Brian's Marina, which is consistent with Trailer 2 but not independently verified here.

intel.title: Official size: about twice GTA V
intel.summary: Rockstar's Aaron Garbut says Leonida is its largest map by a wide margin, roughly double GTA V's, with no square-kilometre figure.
intel.body: In Game Informer's 14-page cover story (Sep 29, 2026), Garbut stressed density over raw area: rooftops, alleys and interiors. Narrative VP Rupert Humphries said the story steers players around most of the map, but not into every corner. Rockstar has not published dimensions.

intel.title: Preview estimates: 3x RDR2, Vice City 2x Los Santos
intel.summary: Creators who attended a July 2026 Rockstar North preview reported larger comparisons that Rockstar has not formally confirmed.
intel.body: TGG reported the map at about three times Red Dead Redemption 2's playable area, with Vice City alone about twice Los Santos. One estimate claims nearly 11 times GTA V's built-up space. These figures circulate widely but are second-hand.

intel.title: Community measurements: about 85 sq km of land
intel.summary: The fan map's V16 revision cut its land estimate to about 85.6 sq km (from about 110), inside a frame of roughly 21 x 20 km.
intel.body: The September 2026 revision reworked coastlines, beaches and county borders using the leaked map and Extended Look footage. Community figures put GTA V's land at just under 50 sq km, so V16 implies roughly 1.7x GTA V by land. Rockstar's 2x claim may count water or differ in method. Sampling the current GTADB elevation model for this research gave about 83 sq km of land and a land bounding box of about 11.75 x 16.5 km.

intel.title: The August 2026 CyberLeek map leak
intel.summary: On Aug 18, 2026 a group calling itself CyberLeek posted two gameplay clips and an image said to be the full Leonida map. The clips are widely accepted as real; the map is disputed.
intel.body: Takedowns hit re-uploads of the clips, and reports say the footage comes from a 2023-era build. Accounts of the community's view of the map conflict. One outlet says the Mapping Project vouched for it because it matched official geography, while another reports the project's owner called it fake. Mappers nonetheless rebuilt V16 around its outline. Rockstar has not commented. Treat its labels as unconfirmed.

intel.title: Five leaked counties
intel.summary: The leaked map divides Leonida into Lummox (north), Kelly (west), Leonard (east), Vice-Dale (southeast) and Mariana (south) counties.
intel.body: Vice City sits in Vice-Dale, which also reportedly holds a large airport. Mariana covers the southern wetlands and the keys that run far into the southern sea. Lummox is mostly thick forest. Smaller labels include Catalan Bay, Catalan Key, Dalton Island, Gloriana Key and Tequesta Retreat. Kelly and Leonard County names already appeared in trailer signage and police liveries, and Ambrosia County was previously mentioned.

intel.title: The GTA VI Mapping Project
intel.summary: Since September 2022, a fan collective coordinated by DuPz0r has triangulated Leonida from trailers, screenshots, leaks and Florida references.
intel.body: Work began in a GTAForums thread after the 2022 footage leak and grew to hundreds of contributors and a Discord of roughly 17,800 members. Revisions are versioned (V15, V16), and the results feed interactive maps such as GTADB and State of Leonida. The V16 update split the Mount Kalaga park into fragments and gave Port Gellhorn a more intricate coastline. It also clarified how the Keys connect to the mainland. Accuracy claims come from the project itself.

intel.title: 170+ animal species
intel.summary: Leonida holds more than 170 species on land, in the air and at sea, including 60+ bird types and 30+ land mammals, some new to Rockstar games.
intel.body: Named animals include alligators, manatees, flamingos, pelicans, sharks, whales, rays, turtles, jellyfish, iguanas and macaques. Screenshots add a roseate spoonbill, wood storks, a white crane and white-tailed deer. New rendering covers iridescence, bioluminescence and translucency, and fur and feathers can get wet or matted. Dogs can be petted, and the Extended Look ends on a chihuahua in a tutu.

intel.title: Florida's invasive species
intel.summary: Leonida includes famous Florida invaders: green iguanas, cane toads, feral cats and rhesus macaques.
intel.body: Game Informer lists these alongside native animals, mirroring real Florida problem species. Rockstar has not said where they appear on the map.

intel.title: Rare, Discoverable and Legendary animals
intel.summary: Animals can be examined and logged, with Rare, Discoverable and Legendary tiers whose members remain secret.
intel.body: Previews describe a checklist that expands on Red Dead Redemption 2's compendium, covering animals in the wild and in captivity such as zoos. Rockstar has not identified the Legendary animals. Grassrivers' official blurb hints at predators deadlier than alligators.

intel.title: Tropical storms and hurricanes
intel.summary: Leonida gets seasonal tropical storms and hurricanes; frequency and gameplay effects are unannounced.
intel.body: Game Informer confirmed the storms as part of a rebuilt weather system descended from Red Dead Redemption 2's. One cover-story screenshot shows a storm rolling over the Keys with a seaplane.

intel.title: Localized weather, puddles, rainbows and wind
intel.summary: Weather is local and persistent: one district can be stormy while another is sunny, rain leaves puddles, and rainbows can follow showers.
intel.body: Dynamic clouds drive the conditions. A new wind model covers evening offshore breezes, convection updrafts and wind blocked or channelled by buildings, moving hair, debris, water and swamp grass.

intel.title: Most interiors in any GTA
intel.summary: Rockstar says GTA VI has more enterable interiors than any previous GTA, concentrated in the spaces between landmarks.
intel.body: Garbut said interior density reached critical mass, so buildings feel real inside and out. Footage and previews show apartments, an elderly neighbour's flat, a crack den, offices during a corporate gala, an elevator shaft, a recording booth, clothing stores, salons, barbers, gyms, banks and convenience stores. Jason and Lucia share one busy safehouse.

intel.title: Satellite-style pause map and 3D minimap
intel.summary: The pause-menu map uses detailed satellite-style imagery, and the minimap now renders 3D buildings.
intel.body: Preview coverage describes the satellite look. One roundup adds that unexplored areas stay hidden until visited; that detail is reported but not confirmed. Kotaku noted the 3D-building minimap in the Extended Look. Rockstar has still not published a standalone world map.

intel.title: Ways to use the world
intel.summary: Confirmed activities include scuba diving, kayaking, airboating, jet skiing, base jumping, zoos, mini golf, gyms, billiards, street and off-road racing, and dates such as hikes.
intel.body: The Game Informer preview also lists ATV trails, mud parks, demolition derbies, mountain biking, motocross, golf, farms and ranches. Footage shows parachuting from rooftops and snorkelling in the swamps. Hunting appears in a screenshot but has not been detailed.

intel.title: Place names from the Ultimate Edition listing
intel.summary: Rockstar's store copy named new places: Gambit Bay, Washington Beach, Watson Bay, Southside, Stockyard, Lake Leonida and the Vercetti Estate.
intel.body: The Shitzu Squalo boat docks at Washington Beach in Gambit Bay, and a Dominator buggy waits at the Paradise Garage in Watson Bay. The PTT Youngin$ compound is in Southside, and Stock 305 and Electric Fang Tattoo are in Stockyard. One-Eyed Willie's off-road shop is at Lake Leonida, and Mount Kalaga gets backwoods off-road content. Two revolvers come from the Vercetti Estate.

intel.title: What is Gloriana?
intel.summary: Gloriana appears on licence plates in official imagery, and fans long assumed it was a neighbouring state. The leaked map instead shows Gloriana Key, an island by Vice City.
intel.body: Reports on the leak say no Gloriana state appears on it, only an island modelled on Virginia Key. Rockstar has not explained the plates.

intel.title: Official Leonida map poster
intel.summary: Rockstar has listed a Leonida map poster in its Vice City Collection collector's box (marked coming soon). It could be the first official full map.
intel.body: Until the poster or the game ships, every full layout comes from fan reconstruction or the disputed leak.

sources.name: Rockstar Games - Grand Theft Auto VI

intel.title: Real-world inspirations
intel.summary: Vice City mirrors Miami, the Keys mirror the Florida Keys, and Grassrivers mirrors the Everglades. Port Gellhorn resembles the Panhandle, Ambrosia Clewiston, and Lake Leonida Lake Okeechobee.
intel.body: Community landmark matching links hundreds of buildings to real addresses: Kaseya Center becomes the Sahara Arena, E11EVEN becomes NINE1NINE, and the Clevelander becomes the Ocean View Hotel. The Sunshine Skyway inspires the Bocamar Bridge and Sebring the Gellhorn raceway. North-Georgia-style falls and dams fill Mount Kalaga. Outlets expect theme parks and the Space Coast to be left out.

intel.title: Police jurisdictions on the map
intel.summary: Footage shows distinct agencies: Vice City Police (blue and white) and Leonard County Sheriff (green and white), with a Vice Beach PD station on community maps.
intel.body: Agency liveries help place scenes. Leonard County units appear near Waning Sands in Trailer 1. Kelly County appears only on a sign. The new Heat system lets police identify suspects by appearance and location, so geography matters to escapes.

intel.title: The shape of Leonida (community reconstruction)
intel.summary: In the community reconstruction Leonida is taller than wide: forested highlands in the north, a central lake, and Vice City on the southeast bay behind barrier islands. Wetlands cover the southwest, and the Keys arc off the southern tip.
intel.body: The Gulf of Leonida runs down the west coast past Port Gellhorn, the raceway and Capri. The Atlantic runs along the east with a long chain of barrier islands. The Leonida Straits lie south of the Keys. The mainland is widest just below the northern hills and narrows to a point at Hamlet before the islands take over. All of this comes from fan data and the disputed leak.

intel.title: The official setup: an easy score gone wrong
intel.summary: Rockstar's pitch: Jason and Lucia land in a statewide criminal conspiracy after a simple job falls apart.
intel.body: Rockstar's official description sets GTA VI in Vice City and the wider state of Leonida. Jason and Lucia have always had the odds against them, and when an easy score goes wrong they are pulled into a criminal conspiracy that spans the state, leaving them dependent on each other to survive. Coverage and Rockstar's writers frame the story as Bonnie-and-Clyde inspired. The game launches 2026-11-19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, so deeper plot details are not yet official.

sources.name: Rockstar Games - Grand Theft Auto VI

intel.title: Launch trailer fills in Jason and Lucia's pasts
intel.summary: The 90-second October 15 trailer has Lucia calling Jason from prison and Jason explaining his bad Army exit.
intel.body: Released 2026-10-15 and captured on PS5, the launch trailer centers on the leads rather than new systems. Lucia phones Jason from prison, and Jason explains that his Army career ended badly, which has left him unable to get loans or ordinary work. The trailer also shows the couple together in intimate moments and debuts Justice's single Flower in a Hurricane. No new named characters were introduced.

intel.title: Extended Look: the early jobs shown on Netflix
intel.summary: The 27-minute Netflix special strings together several early contracts for Boobie, Brian, Raul and Megamundo.
intel.body: An Extended Look premiered on Netflix on 2026-08-27 and hit YouTube six hours later. It shows the pair building a name as underworld contractors: a drug pickup for Boobie Ike that police raid, a dinner where Brian Heder offers work while warning Jason off going deeper, getaway driving for Raul Bautista that leads to recruitment, and a private-security gig at Megamundo's U.S. headquarters launch that armed men interrupt. Cal Hampton closes it with a talk about seizing their youth.

intel.title: Chapters, roughly 80 hours and choices that matter
intel.summary: Previews describe an RDR2-style chapter structure with big and small choices.
intel.body: Preview coverage from August 2026 says the campaign is chapter-based like Red Dead Redemption 2, with side content woven into the main story. Rob Nelson said his own run took about 80 hours. Choices carry small and large consequences, some delayed, and some story steps require raising set amounts of cash. Missions allow flexible approaches, such as different escape routes or splitting driving and shooting between the leads.

intel.title: Jason and Lucia's romance is optional
intel.summary: The pair stay partners in crime either way; players decide whether the relationship turns romantic.
intel.body: Previews say the relationship can grow romantic or stay platonic based on how you play, and Rockstar has said the two remain partners regardless. Spending time together, such as shopping, working out or pulling robberies, strengthens the bond, while ignoring texts can hurt it. Trailer 2 (2025-05-06) already leaned into the couple's warmth, which Kotaku noted as a shift from the series' usually cynical relationships.

intel.title: Lucia's ankle monitor drives the opening
intel.summary: Previews say her post-prison ankle monitor is central to how the partnership begins.
intel.body: Lucia wears an ankle monitor in key art, trailers and the launch trailer's shower scene. Preview reporting says the device is central to the plot and helps set her partnership with Jason in motion. Rockstar has not explained the mechanics publicly.

intel.title: Trailer 2 day: nine character profiles go live
intel.summary: On 2025-05-06 Rockstar published profiles for Jason, Lucia and seven supporting characters.
intel.body: Alongside Trailer 2, Rockstar's site added full names and backstories for Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos plus Cal Hampton, Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest, Bae-Luxe, Roxy, Raul Bautista and Brian Heder. The profiles also name Lori (Brian's wife), the rapper DWNPLY and the label Only Raw Records. Place pages cover Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.

intel.title: New faces named in the Extended Look
intel.summary: Valentina, Andrés de León, Petra Navarro, Raymond, Ernesto, Méndez, Yago and Camillo emerged from the Netflix special.
intel.body: No new official profiles came with the Extended Look, but its dialogue and scenes surfaced several names now tracked by community databases: Valentina (Val), Megamundo figures Andrés de León and Petra Navarro, drug-house operator Raymond and associate Ernesto (both reportedly San4San), VCPD officer Méndez, street racer Yago and livestreamer Camillo. Treat roles and spellings as provisional until launch.

intel.title: Stephen Root says he's in GTA VI
intel.summary: The King of the Hill actor told the AP he appears in the game; outlets tie him to Brian Heder.
intel.body: In September 2026, Stephen Root told the Associated Press at a BAFTA event that players will see him in GTA VI, noting fans recognized his voice. He did not name the character, but outlets widely match his voice to Brian Heder. He is the first actor to confirm involvement; Rockstar has not announced any cast.

intel.summary: Fans name Dylan Rourke (Jason), Manni L. Perez (Lucia) and Bobby Moynihan (Cal); none are confirmed.

intel.title: LOVE magazine: Raul is the duo's mentor
intel.summary: Rockstar's writers frame Raul as the older pro who brings the big heists.
intel.body: In LOVE Issue 27 (on sale 2026-10-05), Rockstar's narrative team described Jason and Lucia as young, reckless and flawed, and Raul as the experienced mentor who supplies the bigger jobs they could not plan alone. Writer Alexa D'Agostino called Liberty City Lucia's hometown and said Lucia draws partly on her own immigrant mother.

intel.title: The theme: a modest American Dream
intel.summary: Rockstar's narrative chief says the leads want a home and clear debts, not a fortune.
intel.body: Rupert Humphries, Rockstar's senior VP of narrative, told LOVE that the American Dream has shrunk to something modest, like a family home and paid-off loans, and called Leonida a pressure cooker for chaos that fuels the satire. Rockstar says Jason's slide into crime reflects his material circumstances, though players may read it differently.

intel.title: Leonida Man: Trailer 1's viral-video satire
intel.summary: Trailer 1 recreated real Florida-style viral moments as in-game social posts and news.
intel.body: Trailer 1 (2023-12-04) is packed with phone-shot clips echoing real incidents: a woman dancing on a speeding car, a gator pulled from a pool (posted by an OfficialPOACH account), a gator wandering into a store, a nearly naked man fleeing police (PlanetLeonidaMan), a hammer-wielding woman on a livestream, and a tattooed Florida Joker style mugshot on Weazel News. Coverage tied each to real events, several from Florida.

intel.title: Streamers and online challenges in the crosshairs
intel.summary: Rob Nelson names influencers, streamers and risky challenges as satire targets that should age well.
intel.body: Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told French magazine Trois Couleurs that GTA VI aims to be a time capsule of the present, choosing targets that will still read as absurd years later, such as influencers, streamers and dangerous online challenges, while skipping fleeting memes. Examples include a bloody 38-patty burger ad and Camillo, a streamer who keeps broadcasting from a stolen car's trunk during a chase.

intel.title: The phone: Snapmatic, Ryde Me and WAINK
intel.summary: The in-world phone parodies real apps, but the fugitive leads can't post to social media.
intel.body: Snapmatic returns as an Instagram-style feed you can browse and follow, but Jason and Lucia can't upload because they avoid a digital trail. Ryde Me is an Uber-style rideshare used for fast travel, and WAINK scans cars before you steal them. Texting between the leads also exists, and ignoring messages can strain their relationship.

intel.title: No real brands, only parodies
intel.summary: Take-Two's CEO says GTA VI has no product placement or brand collaborations.
intel.body: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told Variety that GTA VI's world is entirely fictional, so it carries no real product placement or brand deals, unlike NBA 2K. Instead the game leans on parody brands such as eCola, Pißwasser, Chacey's and the Megamundo network.

intel.summary: Rockstar's 2026-10-08 reveal paired stations with hosts like Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey and Robyn.
