intel.title: Justice composed the original score
intel.summary: The French duo scored the game and debuted Flower in a Hurricane in the launch trailer.
intel.body: On 2026-10-15 Rockstar confirmed that Justice composed GTA VI's original score. Their single Flower in a Hurricane, featuring Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, soundtracks the launch trailer and appears on The Album.

intel.title: Rumor: Rockstar pitched a Daft Punk reunion
intel.summary: A music-leak account claims Rockstar offered Daft Punk a huge budget before going with Justice.
intel.body: Music rumor account Has It Leaked claimed on 2026-10-20 that Rockstar pitched Daft Punk's management a final comeback with an essentially unlimited budget, with Justice as the fallback. Neither Rockstar nor Daft Punk has commented. The only Daft Punk link on the soundtrack is Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo's reported work on Travis Scott's RHYNO.

sources.name: Mixmag Asia - Daft Punk reunion report

intel.title: Rumored extra radio stations from leaks
intel.summary: Leak trackers list stations like Vice City FM, V-Rock and Emotion 98.3 beyond the official six.
intel.body: Kotaku's running tracker lists stations not in Rockstar's reveal, including Kaleidoscope FM, Worldwide FM, Emotion 98.3, Radio ON-U, Symphony FM, V-Rock, Stockyard FM, Circo Loco Records Radio, The Wipe, La Ola and Vice City FM. Kotaku notes leaked material may not match the final game, so treat these as unconfirmed.

sources.name: Kotaku - Every song and radio station spotted so far

intel.title: CyberLeek leaks may contain story spoilers
intel.summary: An anonymous leaker has posted unreleased footage since August 2026, including a 25-minute clip with cutscenes.
intel.body: Since mid-August 2026 a leaker calling itself CyberLeek has posted unreleased GTA VI footage, tied to a crypto token. An October 8 drop of roughly 25 minutes reportedly includes mission cutscenes and racing content. Authenticity and build status are not independently verified, Take-Two is pursuing legal action, and this hub does not reproduce leaked plot details.

sources.name: Kotaku - Massive GTA 6 leak reveals story spoilers

intel.title: Ultimate Edition adds shops, Wyman and a gang raid
intel.summary: The $99.99 edition threads extra businesses and missions through the story chapters.
intel.body: Per June 2026 coverage, the Ultimate Edition adds businesses including Rideout Customs, One-Eyed Willie's, Stock 305, Goodtime Gear (Macca the Gator merch), Sara's Unisex Salon and Electric Fang Tattoo with FAILE designs. It also adds the Classic Car Collection activity for collector Wyman and a raid on the PTT Youngin$ compound. The Vintage Vice City pre-order pack nods to Tommy Vercetti with a palm-tree weapon pattern.

intel.title: Macca the Gator's $400 collector's box
intel.summary: Rockstar's Goodtime State box is all merch, no game, built around a fictional TV gator.
intel.body: Announced in September 2026, The Goodtime State - Vice City Collection costs $399.99, ships 2026-11-19 and excludes the game. It centers on Macca the Gator, mascot of a hit in-game Leonida TV show, with a stash-compartment figure, Oakley sunglasses, a New Era cap, a Chunkee the Manatee shot glass and a Leonida map poster. Fans criticized the price.

sources.name: GTABase - Goodtime State collector's box announced

intel.title: Real Miami club answers the Nine1Nine parody
intel.summary: E11EVEN released its own GTA-style trailer after Trailer 1 lampooned it.
intel.body: Trailer 1 included a plane banner for Nine1Nine, a fictional club modeled on Miami's E11EVEN. In December 2023 E11EVEN responded with a playful parody trailer of its own, reusing the Tom Petty song from Rockstar's trailer and a banner equating the two clubs.

sources.name: EDMTunes - E11EVEN responds with GTA VI parody trailer

intel.title: The first mainline GTA story without Dan Houser
intel.summary: Rupert Humphries and Michael Wiafe lead the writing; Houser left Rockstar in 2020.
intel.body: Dan Houser, who co-wrote earlier GTA games, left Rockstar in 2020 and has said he did not write GTA VI. Narrative SVP Rupert Humphries and writer Michael Wiafe are credited on the Extended Look, with Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern and Alexa D'Agostino also interviewed as writers.

sources.name: Wikipedia - Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look

intel.title: Dual protagonists: Jason and Lucia
intel.summary: Swap freely between Jason and Lucia in the open world, or play together with one driving while the other shoots.
intel.body: The Extended Look showed seamless swaps between the two leads mid-chase, including a hand-off to Lucia for a getaway and a parachute jump from a skyscraper. Previews say switching is open in free roam but can be locked during some story moments. In a shared car the pair can trade seats, and the one you are not controlling follows their own daily schedule and can be phoned to meet up.

intel.title: Relationship and optional romance
intel.summary: The bond between Jason and Lucia grows through shared activities, and the romance is optional.
intel.body: Previews describe a relationship that strengthens when the pair work out, shop, sightsee or commit crimes together, and that can sour if you keep ignoring your partner's texts. Players can keep things platonic. The romance is described as roleplay with no gameplay unlocks, though bond strength may change how some scenes play out. Couples can hold hands and hold doors for each other.

intel.title: Story structure, choices and length
intel.summary: A chapter-based campaign with choices and side content blended in. One reported dev playthrough took about 80 hours.
intel.body: Previews describe RDR2-style chapters, open-world encounters that flow into the main story, and choices whose consequences can be immediate or delayed. Missions offer multiple approaches, such as different escape routes from a high-rise. Money matters more than in past games: some story beats require reaching a cash target. Rockstar North co-head Rob Nelson's playthrough reportedly ran about 80 hours.

intel.title: Six-star, witness-driven wanted system
intel.summary: The wanted level now goes to six stars, and police only respond when someone or something reports you.
intel.body: Police are alerted by witnesses or security systems and arrive knowing details of the incident. The crime scene can stay an active search zone after you escape. One star is easy to lose, while six triggers a full manhunt. Overhauled sprinting, vaulting and climbing help with on-foot escapes through alleys. Getting caught shows a Busted screen, and one partner can be arrested while the other stays free.

intel.title: Police identification and disguises
intel.summary: Cops can know your face, outfit or car, and changing them can throw them off.
intel.body: Icons under the wanted meter show what police know. A full outfit change works, but a hat or glasses alone do not. A barber visit can clear your description, and a mask worn during a crime then thrown away hides your face from witnesses and cameras. Swapping an identified getaway car blunts the search, and partners can split up to divide police attention. Outlined stars mean officers are searching without a visual on you.

intel.title: Criminal Profile reputation system
intel.summary: Replaces RDR2's Honor meter with a profile that tracks how you behave, not just good or evil.
intel.body: Needless violence and destruction count against you, while efficient, clean jobs build a reputation as capable criminals. Violence a mission requires does not automatically hurt your profile, and small acts such as binning trash properly can register. The profile shapes how residents react and how parts of the story unfold. The Extended Look also showed petting a dog earning positive karma.

intel.title: Robberies, stick-ups and heists
intel.summary: Rob stores, diners, jewelers and banks solo or as a pair, trading speed against loot.
intel.body: Robberies force a choice: blow a safe fast and risk damaging valuables, or crack the combination and keep the full haul while police get closer. Officers may surround a building and wait you out, so secondary exits matter. Joint jobs improve the couple's relationship. The Extended Look showed a diner robbery, partner-assisted stick-ups, smaller heists, and a jewelry store where a bystander intervened and had to be subdued.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

intel.title: Tiered car theft and the WAINK app
intel.summary: Stealing cars is now a skill: scan, pick a tool, beat the tracker.
intel.body: Cars fall into security tiers. The WAINK phone app scans a parked car to show its value, registration cost, locks, alarm and tracking hardware. Older cars open with a slim jim, while high-end models need gear like key cloners, some unlocked through story progress. GPS-tracked cars report to police, so you must outrun the signal or ditch the car. Carjacking occupied cars still works.

intel.title: Fences and the criminal economy
intel.summary: Stolen cars and jewelry must be sold through specialist fences, and condition affects payouts.
intel.body: Vehicle fences pay less for visibly damaged cars, which is a challenge on Vice City's narrow, busy streets. Fences may also tip you off to valuable targets, including cars in police impound lots. Garages from the pre-order and Ultimate Edition bonuses include spots to deposit stolen goods.

intel.title: Combat: cover, non-lethal shots and slow-mo aiming
intel.summary: Gunplay resembles RDR2 with a hint of Max Payne 3, and you can wound or disarm instead of kill.
intel.body: Footage showed cover-based shootouts in a high-rise, a slow-motion targeting mode with color-coded body zones, and the option to shoot arms or legs to disable enemies or knock guns from their hands. Especially violent moments can trigger cinematic slow-mo camera angles. Guns can be picked up and carried, and weapons can be hidden before entering a store.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

intel.title: Focus mechanic and NPC interactions
intel.summary: Hold to focus on people, animals and objects, then greet, taunt, provoke or defuse.
intel.body: A Focus mode borrowed and expanded from RDR2 highlights nearby objects and helps you avoid police. The interaction menu lets you greet, antagonize or calm NPCs. Residents notice eavesdropping, confront you if you tail them too long, and some are armed and may strike first. Ambient chatter can turn into side activities, and some standoffs can be settled with a threat instead of a shot.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

intel.title: NPC density, variety and animation
intel.summary: Crowded streets, individually art-directed residents, and reportedly over 600,000 NPC animations.
intel.body: Previews report more than 600,000 NPC animations, versus roughly 55,000 in GTA V and 300,000 in RDR2. Residents are hand-designed rather than assembled from random parts, with a wider range of heights and body types and animations that scale to each body. Digital Foundry singled out crowd and traffic density and blamed them for the CPU load behind the 30fps target. NPCs also livestream chases, and you can tune in.

intel.title: Phone, apps and in-game social media
intel.summary: A physical in-world phone with Snapmatic, livestreams, Ryde Me rideshare and the WAINK car scanner.
intel.body: The camera moves to the character's hand when the phone is out. Snapmatic returns as an Instagram parody: you can browse, follow and read threads, but the fugitive leads cannot post photos. Ryde Me rideshare doubles as fast travel, with chatter between passengers, and WAINK scans cars before theft. NPC livestreams pop up during chases, and the phone also carries radio and podcasts to earbuds on foot.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

intel.title: Shared safehouse and camp-style bases
intel.summary: Jason and Lucia share a home that works more like an RDR2 camp, with people coming and going.
intel.body: Safehouses have more interactive features than past GTA homes: watch TV, grab a beer from the fridge, change clothes, or trim hair and beards in the mirror. Other characters drop by, and some bases belong to allies. Each lead can own personal vehicles parked at home, and bonus garages add weapon lockers and stashes for stolen goods.

intel.title: Clothes, hair, tattoos and disguises
intel.summary: Clothing stores, barbers, salons and tattoo parlors return, and appearance changes double as police evasion.
intel.body: New hairstyles need a barber or salon, while trims can be done at home. Stores carry different stock, and shop entrances show what is sold and whether cameras are present. Car trunks can hold spare outfits for quick changes. The Ultimate Edition adds Sara's Unisex Salon, Stock 305 clothing and Electric Fang Tattoo, which has more than 50 FAILE designs. Wigs and disguises appear in missions.

intel.title: Fitness, diet and sleep
intel.summary: Workouts build muscle, overeating adds weight, and sleep affects recovery.
intel.body: Physique responds to exercise and diet: muscle fades if neglected, and junk food piles on weight. Meals restore a lot of health, and consumables show status icons for temporary buffs. Per Rob Nelson, sleep quality governs how fast attributes regenerate, and skipping sleep leaves visible eye bags. Coffee and energy drinks briefly boost workout stamina.

sources.name: Game Rant - fishing, hunting and stats
The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

intel.title: Swimming and scuba diving
intel.summary: Underwater exploration returns, and swimming uses a lung-capacity meter.
intel.body: Scuba diving was shown in the Extended Look and is on the activity list Rockstar gave Game Informer. Rob Nelson said swimming replaces the stamina bar with a lung-capacity meter. Coastal play is backed by kayaks, jet skis, airboats and fishing boats.

sources.name: Game Rant - fishing, hunting and stats
The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

intel.title: Localized weather, wind and hurricanes
intel.summary: A rebuilt weather system with local storms, persistent puddles, smarter wind, and hurricanes and tropical storms.
intel.body: In the Game Informer cover story, Rockstar's Owen Shepherd described weather that is localized and persistent: one district can be sunny while another is drenched, and wet ground lingers after rain, sometimes with rainbows. Wind models evening offshore breezes, rising warm air and buildings blocking gusts, moving hair, water and swamp grass. Hurricanes and tropical storms bring heavy rain, thunder and runoff. Rockstar has not said how often they hit or whether they affect missions.

sources.name: Game Informer - GTA VI digital issue

intel.title: Wildlife: 170+ species and a field checklist
intel.summary: More than 170 animal species, including legendary variants, with a study checklist and dogs you can pet or scold.
intel.body: Rockstar's Game Informer interviews put the count above 170 species, with legendary variants in the style of RDR2. Alligators are the signature animal and appear in official trailers and screenshots. Previews describe examining animals to log them on a checklist, and the Extended Look showed petting dogs and a study prompt. Hunting is reportedly in and can earn money, while fishing is catch-and-release.

intel.title: Leonida map size and regions
intel.summary: Roughly twice GTA V's map, spanning Vice City, the Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.
intel.body: Aaron Garbut told Game Informer the map is about double GTA V's and Rockstar's biggest yet. Rupert Humphries said the story will not take you everywhere, so exploration is rewarded. Named regions include Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers (Everglades), Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. Bonus content also names Lake Leonida, Washington Beach, Watson Bay, Gambit Bay and Ocean Beach. The pause map uses detailed satellite-style imagery.

intel.title: Interiors and environmental destruction
intel.summary: Detailed enterable interiors and more destructible environments.
intel.body: The Extended Look moved seamlessly from streets into elevators, a high-rise office, a diner, a jewelry store, clubs and a strip club, and Rockstar stresses detail down to rooftops and alleys. Shooting tears up office interiors and glass, an officer was thrown through a wall, and toppling police cars knock down signal posts and trees. Rockstar has given no count of enterable buildings.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

intel.title: Vehicle ownership, storage and mod shops
intel.summary: Personal vehicles, trunk storage for guns and outfits, and tuning shops.
intel.body: Each lead can own vehicles kept at home. Trunks store weapons and spare clothes, and burning a getaway car stops tracking but does not clear the wanted level. Ultimate Edition owners get Rideout Customs (tuning), One-Eyed Willie's off-road shop in Lake Leonida, and a classic-car restoration side job for collector Wyman. Standard players can still customize cars, though Rockstar has not listed standard-edition shops.

intel.title: Ultimate Edition and pre-order content
intel.summary: $79.99 Standard, $99.99 Ultimate with exclusive vehicles, weapons, shops and missions, plus the Vintage Vice City Pack for early buyers.
intel.body: Ultimate adds the '95 Grotti Cheetah, '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy, Shitzu Squalo, Dinka Enduro and Crest kayak, the Morgan revolvers and engraved ES9 and K17 pistols, and several shops: salon, clothing, tattoo, two mod shops, the Paradise Garage and a PTT Youngin$ illegal-goods store. Missions include a gang compound raid and a classic-car restoration commission. Rockstar says the extras tie into Jason and Lucia's story. Every purchase before Nov 20 adds the Vintage Vice City Pack, and digital pre-orders add a GTA+ month.

intel.title: Gyms and workouts
intel.summary: Buy a membership, lift with trigger-controlled reps, and train together as a couple.
intel.body: Gym membership is bought at the front desk. Weightlifting uses the triggers to control each rep, and both leads can train side by side, which Nelson framed as an emergent date. Outdoor gyms appeared in Trailer 2 and dumbbell work in the Extended Look.

sources.name: Game Rant - fishing, hunting and stats

intel.title: Fishing and hunting
intel.summary: RDR2-level fishing that is catch-and-release only, and hunting that can earn cash.
intel.body: Rob Nelson told TGG that fishing is as detailed as RDR2's but every catch must be released, because keeping fish did not suit this game. Hunting is introduced through a character who already knows Jason, and it can earn money. Rockstar's Ultimate Edition copy references fishing in Gambit Bay aboard the Squalo, and official screenshots show hunters with rifles and shotguns.

intel.title: Street, track, rally and motocross racing
intel.summary: Organized car races, illegal street racing with car meets, off-road and rally events, and motocross.
intel.body: The Extended Look featured an organized track race, neon-lit street racing and car-meet culture, rally racing, and dirt-bike motocross. Game Informer's activity list includes street and off-road racing. A Launch Trailer shot shows a dirt-bike ramp jump.

intel.title: Nightclubs, parties and strip clubs
intel.summary: Drink, dance and tip, and clubs also feature in some missions.
intel.body: The Extended Look showed clubbing with drinking and dancing, a party, and a strip club where you can throw money at dancers. Clubs also play a role in certain missions.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

intel.title: Leisure: water sports, games and sightseeing
intel.summary: Kayaking, jet skis, airboats, base jumping, pool, mini golf, basketball, arcades, the zoo and more.
intel.body: Confirmed or shown pastimes include kayaking, jet skiing, airboating, scuba diving, parachuting and base jumping, billiards, mini golf, basketball, arcade machines, zoo visits and sunbathing. Previews add shopping and sightseeing as couple activities. The partner may suggest detours to nearby activities.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

intel.title: Fight rings and backyard wrestling
intel.summary: Underground bare-knuckle fights and backyard wrestling, absent from GTA V.
intel.body: Trailer 2 showed Lucia in an illegal fight, and the Extended Look included fighting rings and backyard wrestling. Rockstar has not detailed how melee moves are learned or upgraded.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

intel.title: Radio on foot and first-ever podcasts
intel.summary: Six stations revealed, with earbud listening on foot and on-demand podcasts.
intel.body: Rockstar revealed Cocoteo FM (Latin), Back Country Radio (country), AfroBank FM (African and amapiano), The Chamber 106.6 (metal), Flash FM (pop) and Dirty South Classics (Southern rap). For the first time, music and talk play through the character's phone and earbuds while walking. On-demand podcasts are new to the series. Rockstar reportedly will not reveal the full station list before launch.

intel.title: Original score by Justice
intel.summary: French duo Justice composed GTA VI's original score, and a soundtrack album launches with the game.
intel.body: Rockstar confirmed Justice alongside the Oct 15 Launch Trailer, which uses their new single with Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard. It is the duo's first video game project. Rockstar's site also promotes GTA VI: The Album, and Phil Collins' music appears in the Extended Look.

intel.title: The Extended Look (Aug 27, 2026)
intel.summary: Rockstar's first real gameplay showcase: about 26 minutes captured on base PS5, premiered on Netflix.
intel.body: The Extended Look premiered on Netflix the afternoon of Aug 27, 2026, then went up on Rockstar's site and YouTube that evening. It ran about 26 minutes, all captured on a base PS5. It covered character switching, robberies, chases, the six-star wanted system, combat, interiors and a long list of side activities. Hands-on and behind-closed-doors previews from outlets including IGN and the New York Times ran alongside it.

intel.title: RAGE engine: ray-traced GI and reflections on base PS5
intel.summary: Digital Foundry found ray-traced global illumination and reflections running on a base PS5 at about 1440p.
intel.body: GTA VI runs on Rockstar's in-house RAGE engine. Digital Foundry's Extended Look analysis found RTGI and ray-traced reflections on cars, glass and characters on base PS5, calling the lighting world-class with some residual noise. Internal resolution looked like a fixed 1440p with a simple spatial upscale to 4K rather than temporal reconstruction, leaving some softness and shimmer. Trailer 2 (May 2025) was estimated at about 1152p with FSR.

sources.name: Game Rant - DF findings and PS5 Pro

intel.title: Frame rate: locked 30fps on consoles
intel.summary: Console builds target 30fps. Digital Foundry measured a very stable lock, and no 60fps mode is announced.
intel.body: Rob Nelson said console builds currently run at 30fps and did not commit to a 60fps option, saying he would check with the tech team. Digital Foundry measured an unusually tight 30fps lock across the Extended Look with rare single-frame drops. It attributes the cap to CPU-heavy simulation of crowds, traffic and physics, so a 60fps console mode looks unlikely. A wiki recap says Rockstar will consider higher-frame-rate modes post-launch, but this is not confirmed on the record.

intel.title: PS5 features and 'plays best on PS5' partnership
intel.summary: DualSense haptics and adaptive triggers, Tempest 3D Audio and SSD fast loading, under a Sony-Rockstar marketing tie-in.
intel.body: A June 24, 2026 PlayStation Blog post co-signed with Rockstar lists haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, the controller speaker, 3D audio and near-instant loading. Rockstar's site carries a 'Plays Best On PS5' badge, but Xbox Series X|S launches the same day. Two limited-edition GTA VI DualSense controllers ($84.99) release Nov 19.

sources.name: PlayStation Blog - plays best on PS5
PlayStation Blog - GTA VI DualSense controllers

intel.title: Xbox Series X|S version
intel.summary: Launches day one on Xbox Series X and Series S, but no Xbox footage has been shown.
intel.body: Every official trailer and the Extended Look were captured on PS5. Analysts expect Series S to target 30fps at a much lower resolution (around 720p) because of its memory limits, but that is a prediction. Take-Two's CEO has dismissed Series S performance concerns without giving specifics.

intel.title: Camera: third-person focus, no full first-person at launch
intel.summary: Rockstar built GTA VI around third-person animation. First-person is limited to aiming some weapons.
intel.body: Rob Nelson said the team prioritized third-person animation, so there is no full first-person mode at launch. For comparison, GTA V's first-person mode arrived a year after release with the next-gen version. Leaked dev-build clips showing first-person driving and walking are unconfirmed and may reflect debug tools.

intel.title: PC version and modding outlook
intel.summary: No PC version announced, so no official mod support yet. Rockstar did buy FiveM maker Cfx.re in 2023.
intel.body: GTA VI launches only on consoles. At the Sept 17, 2026 shareholder meeting, Zelnick reiterated that Take-Two eventually targets every platform with a meaningful audience, without naming GTA VI. Rockstar's past games reached PC months to years after console launch. In August 2023 Rockstar acquired Cfx.re, the team behind the FiveM and RedM roleplay mods, signaling friendlier relations with modders, but it has said nothing about GTA VI mods.

intel.title: Accessibility (not yet detailed)
intel.summary: Rockstar has not published GTA VI's accessibility options. Job listings point to new captioning and text-to-speech work.
intel.body: No official accessibility feature list exists yet. Rockstar job postings asked for accessibility evaluation and audit experience, captioning and text-to-speech. Claims about colorblind modes, full remapping and a 13-language subtitle set remain unverified until menus or store pages confirm them.

intel.title: Install size and pre-load
intel.summary: Pre-load opens Nov 12. The official file size is unpublished, and community estimates run about 150-200 GB.
intel.body: Digital pre-orders and boxed code copies can pre-load from Nov 12, 2026. As of late October, store listings showed no size. Widely shared figures trace back to an unverified 2024 leak, and a viral 676.7 GB screenshot is a hoax.

intel.title: GTA Online for VI: not at launch
intel.summary: GTA VI launches as a single-player game. A new online mode is expected later with no date.
intel.body: Take-Two's pre-order release describes the Nov 19 launch as a single-player experience. Twitch CEO Dan Clancy told Bloomberg he expects a bigger viewership bump when multiplayer launches the following year, but Rockstar has not confirmed timing, crossplay or progress transfer. GTA V's online launched about two weeks after that game, so a gap is not unprecedented.

intel.title: GTA+ and the existing GTA Online
intel.summary: Digital pre-orders include a free month of GTA+, and Rockstar still promotes the current GTA Online.
intel.body: The pre-order release bundles a free GTA+ month, giving access to GTA V and the GTA+ Games Library, and calls GTA Online ever-evolving. Reports say Take-Two intends to keep supporting the current GTA Online after VI launches. No carry-over of GTA Online progress into VI has been announced.

intel.title: Roleplay community outlook
intel.summary: Rockstar owns Cfx.re (FiveM and RedM), fueling hopes for official roleplay support in VI's online mode.
intel.body: Rockstar's August 2023 purchase of Cfx.re brought the biggest GTA roleplay platforms in-house after years of conflict. Cfx.re asked fans not to ask about the next GTA. Twitch's CEO said his company has worked with Rockstar on ways to involve creators. Nothing about VI roleplay servers is announced.

intel.title: 2026 Cyberleek leaks (spoiler warning)
intel.summary: A leaker has posted development-build footage since August 2026, and Rockstar has asked fans to wait.
intel.body: About 15 clips surfaced the week before the Netflix reveal. A roughly 25-minute video followed on Oct 8 with nudity, first-person footage and a dirt-bike sequence, then an Oct 10 ultimatum threatening the full story unless Take-Two ships discs and apologizes. Rockstar's only statement, posted on Instagram in late August, called the leaks heartbreaking. Footage is from a dev build and may not match the final game.

intel.title: The story so far: what the premise is
intel.summary: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos have long known the odds are against them. When what should have been an easy score goes wrong, the pair end up in Vice City, caught in a criminal conspiracy that spreads across the state of
intel.body:
Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos have long known the odds are against them. When what should have been an easy score goes wrong, the pair end up in Vice City, caught in a criminal conspiracy that spreads across the state of Leonida (Rockstar's satirical take on Florida), and they have to lean on each other to survive. Rockstar frames it as a Bonnie-and-Clyde-style crime partnership told in chapters: Jason is an ex-soldier drifting through drug-runner work in the Keys, Lucia is newly out of prison and determined to change her luck. As of 2026-10-26 the game has not launched (release set for 2026-11-19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S), so only marketing-level story details are official.

Themes: Bonnie-and-Clyde partnership: trust, loyalty and an optional romance between two equals, A shrunken American Dream: a home, a supported family and cleared debts rather than vast wealth, Second chances after prison and a bad military exit; crime driven by material circumstances, Satire of influencers, streamers and risky online challenges, 'Florida Man' style viral absurdity, recast as Leonida Man moments on social feeds and news, Consumer and advertising parody (giant fast-food items, pharma ads, fake beers and sodas), The hustle of the Vice City music and nightlife scene (labels, strip clubs, viral rap), Modern policing, surveillance and a six-star wanted system

regions.name: Vice City
regions.summary: Leonida's neon metropolis and the game's main hub, a modern parody of Miami.
regions.body: Rockstar describes Vice City as America's glamour, hustle and greed packed into one city. The official site's tagline calls it the dark side of the sunniest place in America. Officially named parts include Ocean Beach, Little Cuba, the Tisha-Wocka flea market and the VC Port, and later material adds Stockyard, Southside, Washington Beach and Bayside. Preview attendees put the city at roughly twice the size of Los Santos. In the community reconstruction it fills the southeast quadrant. The mainland downtown faces the barrier island of Vice Beach across a bay, and the airport sits to the west.
regions.inspiration: Present-day Miami and Miami Beach: Brickell, Downtown, Wynwood, Little Havana, South Beach, the Venetian Islands, PortMiami and MIA.
regions.vibe: Neon nightlife, art deco beachfront, glass towers, influencers and street crime.

sources.name: Rockstar Games - Grand Theft Auto VI

regions.name: Leonida Keys
regions.summary: A tropical island chain off the southern tip of the mainland, where Jason lives and works for drug runners.
regions.body: Rockstar pitches the Keys as a laid-back island paradise of retirees, casual boating, dive bars and sea turtles, while warning that its waters are among the most dangerous in America. On the character pages Jason works for local drug runners here, and Brian Heder runs a boat yard as a front. Trailer 2 opens in the Keys. In the community map the chain starts at Key Lento and arcs southwest, then west, along the bottom of the map, linked by an overseas highway and ending at a key with an airfield.
regions.inspiration: The Florida Keys: Key Largo (Key Lento), the Overseas Highway and Seven Mile Bridge, Key West, the Cudjoe Key aerostat and the Aquarius undersea lab.
regions.vibe: Marinas, dive bars, mangrove channels, boat culture and quiet smuggling.

regions.name: Grassrivers
regions.summary: Everglades-style wetlands of murky water, mangroves and airboats on the southwest mainland.
regions.body: Rockstar frames Grassrivers as untamed marshland and says it hides predators more dangerous than its alligators. Official screenshots and trailers show airboats, stilt homes, a visitor centre and police in the swamp, and Game Informer's images include a wetland at sunrise and gators at a night-time dock. The Extended Look added manatees swimming through the swamps and Jason snorkelling in deep water. The community reconstruction puts it across the low southwest mainland between Vice City's western edge and the Gulf, with Watson Bay on the coast.
regions.inspiration: Everglades National Park and the Tamiami Trail and Flamingo areas.
regions.vibe: Humid, lawless, buggy backwater where bodies disappear.

regions.name: Port Gellhorn
regions.summary: A decaying former tourist town on Leonida's forgotten Gulf coast.
regions.body: Rockstar's blurb describes a vacation spot gone to seed. Shops sit empty, and its parking lots are littered with cheap booze, painkillers and truck-stop energy drinks. Official screenshots show the Starlet Motel and a strip-mall club. A community trailer guide links the convenience-store robbery that ends Trailer 1 to a Pawn & Gun here. Mappers place it on the west and northwest Gulf coast in Kelly County, around a bay crossed by a cable-stayed bridge, with a container port, a trailer park and a large road course to the south.
regions.inspiration: Florida Panhandle towns, especially Panama City and Callaway (community building matches). The Forgotten Coast nickname is a real Florida term for that stretch. One outlet compares it to a worse Atlantic City.
regions.vibe: Seedy motels, pawn shops, biker bars and faded beach-town neon.

regions.name: Ambrosia
regions.summary: An inland sugar-company town billed as the heart of Leonida, with factories and a biker gang.
regions.body: Rockstar describes Ambrosia as a place of traditional values, where locals work in factories around the Allied Crystal sugar refinery and a local biker gang supplies most other needs. Official screenshots show bikers by the refinery, a burning farm, a patriotic-themed car wash and mayoral campaign signs. Game Informer added a neon biker bar and a crop duster over fields. Community mappers place the town inland, a little north of centre, on the southwest side of Lake Leonida, with a raceway park, a rail station and a police department nearby.
regions.inspiration: Clewiston, Florida (US Sugar's mill town on Lake Okeechobee) and the wider sugar-cane belt. Community matches point to buildings in Clewiston and Arcadia.
regions.vibe: Smokestacks, cane fields, pickup trucks and outlaw bikers.

regions.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
regions.summary: A forested, hilly national park on Leonida's northern edge, known for hunting, fishing and off-road trails.
regions.body: Rockstar's description promotes prime hunting, fishing and off-road trails, along with odd backwoods locals. Official imagery shows streams, steep forest roads, muddy trails, deer and a cougar. Game Informer's screenshots add a hunter on an ATV watching deer and a waterfall hiking trail, and the Ultimate Edition text calls it backwoods off-road country. In the community map it covers the northern highlands, the only significant elevation in the state. The V16 update split the park into fragments based on the leaked map.
regions.inspiration: Not stated by Rockstar. Community landmark matches point to north Georgia and the southern Appalachians (Amicalola Falls, Tallulah Falls Dam, Table Rock Mountain), and one fan site cites Providence Canyon. Florida's own Ocala-style forests are a plausible tonal reference.
regions.vibe: Pine and hardwood wilderness, campers, hunters and moonshine-country weirdness.

regions.name: Vice Beach
regions.summary: The barrier-island beach side of Vice City, home to Ocean Beach and Washington Beach.
regions.body: Vice Beach is the long island east of downtown across the bay, facing the Atlantic. It holds the art deco hotel strip of Ocean Beach, the Lincoln Road-style mall where the Effluvia rooftop bar is placed, and Washington Beach further north. Trailers 1 and 2 spend much of their time here. The Vice Beach name appears on the local police department in community map data, but Rockstar's own district names so far are Ocean Beach and Washington Beach.
regions.inspiration: Miami Beach: South Beach, Ocean Drive, Lincoln Road, Mid-Beach and Collins Avenue.
regions.vibe: Pastel hotels, bikini crowds, supercars and party boats.

regions.name: Lake Leonida
regions.summary: A big inland lake next to Ambrosia, officially home to the off-road shop One-Eyed Willie's.
regions.body: Rockstar has used the name: the Ultimate Edition places One-Eyed Willie's off-road modification shop at Lake Leonida. Community maps put the lake slightly northeast of Ambrosia in the state's interior, roughly 1.5 km across. The leaked map shows a large lake in the north-central interior.
regions.vibe: Bass boats, levees, cane fields and mud trucks.

regions.name: Watson Bay
regions.summary: A small Gulf-coast fishing town on the edge of Grassrivers, home of the Paradise Garage.
regions.body: The Ultimate Edition listing says a buggy is stored at the Paradise Garage in Watson Bay. A water tower labelled Watson Bay appears in official screenshot material. Community mappers place the town on the southwest coast where the Grassrivers wetlands meet the Gulf, with a marina, a seafood shack and a small airstrip.
regions.inspiration: Old Gulf fishing villages. Community matches use Cedar Key structures (water tower, bridge, airport), while the location mirrors Everglades City.
regions.vibe: Stilt houses, crab boats and swampy isolation.

regions.name: Hamlet
regions.summary: A small farm-belt town south of Vice City on the road to the Keys, near the Leonida Penitentiary.
regions.body: Hamlet appears on signage in official footage, according to community trackers. A Trailer 1 residential scene is attributed to it. Mappers place it on the southern mainland, southwest of Vice City, with the state prison, a water tower, a Fleeca branch and the official Ultimate Edition shop Sara's Unisex Salon.
regions.vibe: Strip malls, nurseries, prison towers and gateway-to-the-Keys traffic.

regions.name: Waning Sands
regions.summary: A suburban strip north of Vice City on the Atlantic side, with the Evergreen Mall.
regions.body: Signage for Waning Sands is reported in official imagery. Community trackers say Trailer 1 shows Leonard County Sheriff cruisers racing through this area. Mappers place it on the northeast coast in Leonard County, with divided highways, the Evergreen shopping centre, a police department, a water tower and a rail station.
regions.inspiration: Broward County suburbs such as Hollywood and Hallandale. Community matches include the Hollywood water tower.
regions.vibe: Big-box sprawl, outlet malls and retirees.

regions.name: Capri
regions.summary: A southwest Gulf-coast town between Grassrivers and the Gellhorn raceway.
regions.body: Capri is reported on signage in official footage. Mappers place it on the west coast below Port Gellhorn, with a fishing pier, a drawbridge, a small stadium and a rail station.
regions.inspiration: Naples, Florida (pier match), with some Sebring structures.

regions.name: Lummox County
regions.summary: Leaked county label for the forested north, including Mount Kalaga.
regions.body: This is one of five county names on the August 18, 2026 leaked map. Reports describe it as thick forest with little settlement. Community data puts Mount Kalaga, the northern islands, Yorktown, Redhill and Millport inside it. Rockstar has not confirmed it.
regions.inspiration: North Florida and southern Georgia backcountry.

regions.name: Kelly County
regions.summary: County label covering the west: Port Gellhorn, the raceway, the Gellhorn Hills and Ambrosia's west side.
regions.body: The Kelly County name was spotted on an exit sign in Trailer 1. As a county with borders it comes from the leaked map, where it spans the western half of the middle of the state. Community data puts Port Gellhorn, the Starlet Motel, Gellhorn International Raceway and the Thrillbilly mud park inside it.
regions.vibe: Rural roads and fading coast towns.

regions.name: Leonard County
regions.summary: East-central county north of Vice City: Waning Sands, Lake Leonida's east shore and the coastal suburbs.
regions.body: Leonard County Sheriff cruisers (green and white) are reported in Trailer 1. The leaked map labels the east-central region with this county name. Community data puts Waning Sands, Belville, the Leonida Zoo, the east side of Ambrosia and the Leonard County barrier island inside it.

regions.name: Vice-Dale County
regions.summary: Southeastern county containing Vice City, Vice Beach and Hamlet.
regions.body: Vice-Dale County is a leaked county label and a clear pun on Miami-Dade, and a police vehicle in Trailer 1 is reported to carry the name. Reports say a large airport sits inside it. Community data puts Vice City, Vice Beach, the bay islands, Hamlet and Peregrine Bay in this county.
regions.vibe: Urban core plus southern farm suburbs.

regions.name: Mariana County
regions.summary: Leaked county label for the southern wetlands and the island chain (Grassrivers, Watson Bay, Capri, the Keys).
regions.body: In the leak, Mariana County holds the southern chain of keys that stretches far into the southern sea. Community data also gives it the Grassrivers mainland, Watson Bay, Capri, the western shallows and Key Lento.
regions.inspiration: Monroe County, Florida (the Keys plus the mainland Everglades).

characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.tagline: Ex-soldier chasing an easy life, finding trouble
characters.description: Jason grew up around grifters and small-time crooks, then joined the Army to get away from a rough adolescence. After the service he drifted back to the Leonida Keys, where he does shakedowns and odd jobs for local drug runners while living rent-free in a property owned by Brian Heder. In the October 2026 launch trailer he explains that his Army exit went badly, which has shut him out of ordinary options such as loans. Rockstar's writers describe him as someone who mostly reacts to decisions made around him, and meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing that ever happened to him.

characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.tagline: Fresh out of prison, playing only smart moves
characters.description: Lucia's father taught her to fight when she was very young, and fighting for her family eventually landed her in Leonida Penitentiary. She got out through sheer luck and is now committed to careful, calculated moves. Her family's roots are in Liberty City, and she is driven by the stable life her mother has long dreamed of; Rockstar's writers describe that dream as modest, like a home and paid-off debts. The launch trailer opens with her calling Jason from prison, and previews say her ankle monitor is central to how their partnership starts. She is the series' first non-optional female lead.

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.tagline: Jason's paranoid, Coast Guard-snooping homebody pal
characters.description: Cal is one of Jason's closest friends and, like Jason, works with Brian Heder in the Keys. Rockstar paints him as a stay-at-home type who eavesdrops on Coast Guard radio traffic while drinking and browsing privately. He is happy living a low-ambition life, in contrast to Jason's bigger plans, and coverage widely describes him as conspiracy-minded. He closes the Extended Look with a chat nudging the couple to make the most of their young adult years.

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.tagline: Vice City street legend turned business mogul
characters.description: Boobie is a Vice City fixture who turned his street years into a legitimate-looking empire of real estate, a strip club and a recording studio. His real passion is Only Raw Records, the label he co-runs with Dre'Quan Priest, which is hunting for a hit. Trailer 2 coverage identifies his strip club as the Jack of Hearts. In the Extended Look, Jason and Lucia handle a drug pickup for him that turns chaotic when police raid the location.

characters.name: Dre'Quan Priest
characters.tagline: Hustler-turned-label boss hungry for a hit
characters.description: Dre'Quan is a young, aspiring music mogul who Rockstar says was always more hustler than gangster. He sold drugs to get by, but breaking into music was always the real goal. He runs Only Raw Records with Boobie Ike and signed the rap duo Real Dimez. Rockstar hints that his habit of booking acts into Boobie's strip club may end as he aims at the wider Vice City music scene.

characters.name: Bae-Luxe
characters.tagline: Half of viral rap duo Real Dimez
characters.description: Bae-Luxe is one half of Real Dimez, the rap duo she formed with her high-school friend Roxy. The two first made money shaking down local dealers before channeling that nerve into raunchy rap tracks and a constant social media presence. An early viral collaboration with local rapper DWNPLY launched their career, followed by five years of ups and downs. They have now signed with Only Raw Records in hopes of landing a second hit.

sources.name: Rockstar Games - Only in Leonida: Boobie Ike / Dre'Quan / Real Dimez

characters.name: Roxy
characters.tagline: Real Dimez co-founder chasing a second hit
characters.description: Roxy is the other half of Real Dimez and Bae-Luxe's friend since high school. Rockstar's profile credits the pair with turning shakedowns of local dealers into a rap career powered by provocative songs and relentless posting online. Their breakthrough came via a hit with rapper DWNPLY, and after years of mixed fortunes they have joined Only Raw Records. Rockstar has not given Roxy a separate solo profile.

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.tagline: Charming veteran bank robber recruiting fresh talent
characters.description: Raul is a seasoned bank robber with confidence, charm and cunning who is always scouting for people willing to take big risks for big payouts. Rockstar warns that his recklessness raises the stakes on every job, eventually forcing his crew to commit further or walk away. Rockstar's writers told LOVE magazine he acts as an older mentor who brings the bigger heists that the inexperienced leads could not set up alone. In the Extended Look, Jason and Lucia drive getaway for him before he recruits them.

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.tagline: Old-school Keys smuggler and Jason's landlord
characters.description: Brian is a throwback drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Leonida Keys, back when he hauled cargo by plane. He still moves product through a boat yard he runs with his third wife, Lori, and has been around long enough to let others do his dirty work. He lets Jason live rent-free in one of his properties in exchange for help with local shakedowns. Stephen Root told the Associated Press in September 2026 that he is in the game, and outlets match his voice to Brian, though neither Root nor Rockstar has named the role.

characters.name: Wyman
characters.tagline: Eccentric car collector offering restoration jobs
characters.description: Wyman is described in Rockstar's edition material as an eccentric collector and local fixer. He anchors the Classic Car Collection activity, where players find abandoned and unfinished project cars for him and then restore and customize them; four of the cars are Ultimate Edition exclusives. Community databases place his business, Wyman's World Auto Salvage Co., in Port Gellhorn.

sources.name: Rockstar Report - GTA 6 characters confirmed and rumoured

characters.name: Macca the Gator
characters.tagline: Alligator star of a hit Leonida TV show
characters.description: Macca the Gator is an in-universe TV character from Leonida who fronts much of GTA VI's merchandise. Rockstar's $399.99 collector's box, The Goodtime State - Vice City Collection, which does not include the game, centers on a Macca figure with a stash compartment plus a Macca mirror. Ultimate Edition material also lists a Goodtime Gear shop stocking Macca merchandise. His role inside the game beyond TV and merch is unknown.

characters.name: Stefanie
characters.tagline: Prison social worker heard in Trailer 1
characters.description: Stefanie is the first voice heard in Trailer 1, speaking with Lucia in a prison office in what looks like a social-worker or case review. Community databases give her surname as Gates and link her to Leonida's corrections system, but Rockstar has not published a profile. Whether she reappears in Lucia's story is unknown.

characters.name: Méndez
characters.tagline: Hard-nosed Vice City cop leading raids
characters.description: Méndez is a Vice City Police Department officer glimpsed in Trailer 2 and named in the Extended Look. He leads a heavy-handed raid on a drug deal that Jason and Lucia are caught up in, and the pair seem to recognize him and keep out of his sight. Rockstar has not published a profile, so his wider role is unclear.

sources.name: Rockstar Report - GTA 6 characters confirmed and rumoured

characters.name: Raymond

characters.description: Raymond appears in the Extended Look running what looks like a Vice City drug house, the site of the deal that police raid. Community databases link him to the San4San street gang and list him as Haitian-American. Rockstar has not published a profile.

sources.name: Rockstar Report - GTA 6 characters confirmed and rumoured

characters.name: Ernesto
characters.tagline: Reported San4San partner in drug production
characters.description: Ernesto is a name tied to the Extended Look that community databases list as a San4San member running a drug-production operation with Raymond. Rockstar has not described him officially, and details about him are thin. Treat his role as unconfirmed until launch.

characters.name: Valentina
characters.tagline: Hires the duo for VIP security work
characters.description: Valentina, also called Val, hires Jason and Lucia as escorts and security for Andrés de León at the opening party for Megamundo's new Vice City headquarters. At the event she introduces them to executive Petra Navarro. Rockstar has not published a profile, so her wider loyalties are unknown.

characters.name: Andrés de León
characters.tagline: Wealthy Megamundo VIP who needs protecting
characters.description: Andrés de León is a wealthy figure connected to Megamundo, the game's Spanish-language TV network. In the Extended Look, Jason and Lucia are hired to escort him at the launch party for the network's first U.S. headquarters, where he would rather party upstairs than show up for the opening speech. His exact job at the company has not been stated.

sources.name: Wikipedia - Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look

characters.name: Petra Navarro
characters.tagline: Megamundo executive hosting the HQ launch
characters.description: Petra Navarro is a senior Megamundo executive whom recaps and community databases call the company's chief operating officer, though Rockstar has not confirmed the title. In the Extended Look she asks Jason to bring Andrés downstairs for the opening speech. Fans read her and Andrés as a couple from their dialogue, which is unconfirmed.

sources.name: Rockstar Report - GTA 6 characters confirmed and rumoured

characters.name: Camillo
characters.tagline: Streamer broadcasting a trunk challenge mid-chase
characters.description: Camillo is a Vice City livestreamer whom Lucia finds in the trunk of a car she steals in the Extended Look. Instead of panicking, he keeps streaming to his chat as the police chase plays out. Rockstar's Rob Nelson has pointed to streamers and risky online challenges as satire targets, and this scene is the clearest example so far. Community databases say his look riffs on a real streamer, which Rockstar has not addressed.

characters.name: Yago
characters.tagline: Ex-addict turned illegal street racer
characters.description: Yago appears in the Extended Look's street-racing sequence, shouting at rival drivers while Jason races a modified Annis Elegy. Community databases describe him as a former cocaine user who took up illegal racing after rehab. Rockstar has not published a profile.

characters.name: Phil
characters.tagline: Mullet-wearing gun-shop pitchman on TV
characters.description: Phil hosts a loud TV commercial for Phil's Ammu-Nation in Trailer 2, firing guns from a rooftop while pitching his store. Fans linked him to Phil Cassidy, the arms dealer from GTA III and Vice City, but this Phil is younger and has both arms. Rockstar has not said whether he is a reimagining, a relative or an unrelated character.

rumors.claim: The roughly 90 early-development clips posted in September 2022 are genuine GTA VI footage taken in a hack of Rockstar.
rumors.origin: Hacker posting as teapotuberhacker on GTAForums, Sept 18, 2022
rumors.notes: Rockstar confirmed the breach within days. The hacker, Lapsus$ member Arion Kurtaj, was later given an indefinite hospital order by a UK court.

rumors.claim: The 2022 leak showed a Vice City setting, two playable leads named Jason and Lucia, and a diner hold-up, plus early police, combat and interior systems.
rumors.origin: 2022 Rockstar hack footage (high-level summary only)
rumors.notes: Vice City, Jason, Lucia and a diner robbery all appear in official 2023-2026 material. Leaked footage was an early test build, so visuals and systems shown there are not representative of the final game.

rumors.claim: Leaked footage suggested an RDR2-style limited weapon loadout instead of GTA V's bottomless arsenal.
rumors.origin: 2022 leak footage, community analysis
rumors.notes: Previews describe guns picked up and held, and car trunks storing weapons and outfits, which fits a limited loadout. Rockstar has not detailed exact carry rules.

rumors.claim: GTA VI stars the series' first female lead, a Latina, in a Bonnie-and-Clyde-style criminal pair, set in a Miami analog.
rumors.origin: Jason Schreier, Bloomberg, July 2022
rumors.notes: Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval are the official co-leads in Vice City, Leonida.

rumors.claim: Rockstar will launch smaller and add new missions and cities to the map through post-launch updates.
rumors.origin: Jason Schreier, Bloomberg, July 2022
rumors.notes: Rockstar has announced no expansion plans. The launch map is already described as about twice GTA V's size.

rumors.claim: GTA VI was first designed around four playable leads before narrowing to two.
rumors.origin: Preview-period reporting relayed by VICE, Aug 2026
rumors.notes: Rockstar has not addressed this on the record. It is a development-history claim with no effect on the final game.

rumors.claim: The base game will cost $100 or more.
rumors.origin: Analyst and social media speculation, 2024-2026
rumors.notes: Take-Two set the Standard Edition at $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition at $99.99.

rumors.claim: Physical copies of GTA VI will not contain a disc at launch.
rumors.origin: Industry reports, early 2026
rumors.notes: Rockstar confirmed that boxed copies hold a download code and go on sale Nov 12 to allow pre-loading. Some retailers said they would not stock code-only boxes.

rumors.claim: A true on-disc edition will follow later, in December 2026 or 2027.
rumors.origin: Polish outlet PPE.pl and retailer chatter
rumors.notes: Take-Two has not announced a disc edition. Sony separately plans to stop pressing discs for new games from January 2028.

rumors.claim: The physical release would be held back to prevent pre-launch leaks.
rumors.origin: Industry report, early 2026
rumors.notes: Take-Two denied a physical delay, and boxed code-only copies arrive Nov 12. Rockstar has not linked the code-in-box decision to leak prevention.

rumors.claim: PS5 Pro will get a 60fps performance mode.
rumors.origin: HipHopGamer and other social media posts
rumors.notes: Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said console builds run at 30fps and would not commit to 60fps. Digital Foundry judged the game CPU-bound, which a GPU upgrade does not fix.

rumors.claim: GTA VI targets 30fps on all consoles.
rumors.origin: Digital Foundry trailer analyses (2025-2026); Rob Nelson in influencer interviews
rumors.notes: Nelson said current console builds run at 30fps. Rockstar has not ruled out post-launch performance modes.

rumors.claim: GTA VI will ship with a full first-person mode like GTA V's re-release.
rumors.origin: Long-running fan expectation; Cyberleek clips showing first-person driving
rumors.notes: Rob Nelson said there is no full first-person mode at launch, though aiming certain weapons switches to a first-person view. Leaked first-person dev-build clips do not change that launch plan.

rumors.claim: Gameplay clips posted by Cyberleek since August 2026 come from a real GTA VI build.
rumors.origin: Cyberleek accounts on X and elsewhere, Aug-Oct 2026
rumors.notes: Rockstar's Instagram statement called the leaks heartbreaking and asked fans to wait for Nov 19, which outlets read as tacit acknowledgment. It never formally authenticated specific clips. Contains spoilers.

rumors.claim: Cyberleek holds the complete story mode and will publish it unless Take-Two ships physical discs and apologizes.
rumors.origin: Cyberleek ultimatum, Oct 10, 2026
rumors.notes: The threat is tied to a memecoin market-cap target. No full playthrough has surfaced and Take-Two has not responded publicly.

rumors.claim: A new leaked clip shows Lucia shopping in a clothing store.
rumors.origin: Social media, Oct 26, 2026
rumors.notes: It appeared around the time review copies reportedly went out. Clothing stores themselves are officially confirmed.

rumors.claim: GTA VI has slipped again to 2027 (February or May).
rumors.origin: Unverified X accounts, a 4chan post and a parody 'Rockstar statement', Aug 2026
rumors.notes: Rockstar keeps listing Nov 19, 2026, released the Launch Trailer on Oct 15 and opened pre-load scheduling. The fake statement was flagged by Community Notes.

rumors.claim: A PC version will arrive in 2027.
rumors.origin: Analyst and outlet extrapolation from past Rockstar port gaps
rumors.notes: No PC version is announced. Zelnick says Take-Two generally targets every platform with a meaningful audience over time, and that Rockstar will announce more in due time.

rumors.claim: GTA VI will come to Nintendo Switch 2, possibly day and date.
rumors.origin: YouTuber Kiwi Talz citing a source; NateTheHate and NashWeedle comments
rumors.notes: The original source later distanced himself from the claim. Nintendo of America deferred to Take-Two, and Rockstar has not mentioned a port.

rumors.claim: GTA VI's online multiplayer will launch separately in 2027.
rumors.origin: Twitch CEO Dan Clancy, Bloomberg interview, Sept 2026
rumors.notes: Rockstar's launch is officially single-player. A later online mode follows GTA V's pattern, but Rockstar has given no date.

sources.name: Notebookcheck - Twitch CEO on GTA 6 Online

rumors.claim: GTA Online characters, money and vehicles will carry over to GTA VI's online mode.
rumors.origin: Fan speculation and SEO 'returning player bonus' posts
rumors.notes: Rockstar has not announced any transfer. Commentators expect a fresh economy, possibly with cosmetic loyalty perks.

rumors.claim: GTA V's GTA Online will shut down when GTA VI launches.
rumors.origin: Fan speculation
rumors.notes: The pre-order deal promotes GTA+ and the ever-evolving GTA Online. Reports say Take-Two plans to keep supporting it after VI.

rumors.claim: GTA VI will have official roleplay servers because Rockstar bought FiveM's maker Cfx.re.
rumors.origin: Community inference after the August 2023 acquisition
rumors.notes: The acquisition is real. Rockstar has announced no GTA VI roleplay feature.

rumors.claim: Rockstar cut hurricanes and extreme weather from GTA VI.
rumors.origin: Sportskeeda report based on unverified claims
rumors.notes: In the Sept 2026 Game Informer cover story, Rockstar confirmed hurricanes and tropical storms.

rumors.claim: About 70% of buildings will be enterable.
rumors.origin: Unverified TikTok leaker
rumors.notes: Rockstar stresses detailed interiors but has given no percentage. Most commentators consider 70% unrealistic at this map scale.

rumors.claim: Leonida is about twice the size of GTA V's map.
rumors.origin: Aaron Garbut (Rockstar) to Game Informer, Sept 2026; long rumored before
rumors.notes: Garbut called it Rockstar's biggest map by some margin but gave no square-mile figure. Fan estimates of roughly 150-170 sq km are extrapolations.

rumors.claim: Leonida's landmass is about three times Red Dead Redemption 2's playable area.
rumors.origin: Preview coverage (New York Times, relayed by VICE), Aug 2026
rumors.notes: It conflicts somewhat with the 2x-GTA-V framing, depending on what counts as playable. Rockstar's own on-record figure is the 2x GTA V comparison.

rumors.claim: GTA VI's budget is $2 billion or more.
rumors.origin: Claim in the 2022 hacker's chat; amplified by outlets
rumors.notes: Take-Two has never disclosed a figure. Analyst estimates cluster around $1-1.5 billion.

rumors.claim: Tommy Vercetti or other classic protagonists will appear.
rumors.origin: Fan theories (Vercetti mansion sightings, etc.)
rumors.notes: Rockstar has confirmed no returning characters. Tommy's actor Ray Liotta died in 2022, so a nod or Easter egg seems more plausible than a role.

rumors.claim: Rockstar offered Daft Punk a near-unlimited budget to reunite for the score before hiring Justice.
rumors.origin: Leak account Has It Leaked, Oct 21, 2026
rumors.notes: No party has commented. Justice composing the original score is officially confirmed.

rumors.claim: Reviews go live on Nov 18, one day before launch, and some coverage is held until launch night.
rumors.origin: NateTheHate; Insider Gaming; BlackBate
rumors.notes: Review codes reportedly went out in late October. Rockstar has not announced an embargo.

rumors.claim: Sony holds a marketing partnership for GTA VI.
rumors.origin: Industry speculation; Rockstar site 'Plays Best On PS5' badge
rumors.notes: A PlayStation Blog post co-signed with Rockstar cites their close partnership. It is not exclusivity: Xbox Series X|S launches the same day.

sources.name: PlayStation Blog - plays best on PS5

rumors.claim: Sony will sell an official PS5 or PS5 Pro console bundle with GTA VI.
rumors.origin: Leakers and retailer speculation
rumors.notes: As of late October only retailer-made bundles and two limited-edition DualSense controllers ($84.99) exist. Sony has announced no console bundle.

sources.name: PlayStation Blog - GTA VI DualSense controllers

rumors.claim: Hunting returns and can earn money, and fishing is catch-and-release only.
rumors.origin: Rob Nelson interview with YouTuber TGG, Sept 2026
rumors.notes: It comes from a Rockstar lead, relayed secondhand. Fishing is also officially referenced in Ultimate Edition material (Gambit Bay).

rumors.claim: Classic stations V-Rock and Vice City FM return.
rumors.origin: Station names spotted in official Rockstar material
rumors.notes: Only six stations have official pages so far, and Rockstar reportedly will not reveal the full list before launch.

rumors.claim: The install size is just under 200 GB (or a viral 676.7 GB figure).
rumors.origin: 2024 leaker post (GTA 6 Intel); hoax image for the larger figure
rumors.notes: Store listings had no size as of Oct 22. The real number should appear when pre-load opens Nov 12. The 676.7 GB image is a hoax that shows Xbox One.

rumors.claim: GTA VI will feature real licensed brands (Ford, Sea-Doo, Riva, etc.).
rumors.origin: Placeholder names in leaked material and fan lists
rumors.notes: Every officially named vehicle uses series parody brands (Grotti, Vapid, Dinka, Shitzu, Crest). Real-brand names in fan lists likely come from dev placeholders.

rumors.claim: GTA VI ships with menus and subtitles in 13 languages and English-only voice acting.
rumors.origin: Fan guides citing store metadata
rumors.notes: Rockstar has not published a language or accessibility sheet. English-only voice acting would match series tradition.

rumors.claim: Rockstar fired UK staff in late 2025 for leaking confidential information.
rumors.origin: Rockstar statement; IWGB union counter-claim of union-busting
rumors.notes: About 31 UK staff were dismissed. Rockstar cites sharing of confidential info, while the union alleges union-busting. A Glasgow employment tribunal ran into October 2026, outcome pending.

sources.name: VGC - UK PM on Rockstar layoffs

faq.a: November 19, 2026. Digital pre-orders and boxed code copies can pre-load from November 12. Rockstar has not announced an unlock time.
No. It moved from fall 2025 to May 26, 2026 and then to November 19, 2026, and that date still stands. Viral 2027 delay claims in 2026 were fake or unverified.
PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, both on day one. There are no PS4 or Xbox One versions.
Not at launch, and no PC version has been announced. Take-Two says it generally expands to platforms with a meaningful audience over time, so a later port is widely expected but undated.
The Standard Edition is $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition is $99.99 (US). The separate $399.99 Vice City Collection box is merchandise only and does not include the game.

faq.q: What do you get in the Ultimate Edition?
faq.a: Extra vehicles ('95 Grotti Cheetah, '67 Dominator Buggy, Shitzu Squalo boat, Dinka Enduro and Crest kayak) and engraved weapons, including the Morgan revolvers and personalized ES9 and K17 pistols. It also unlocks shops such as Rideout Customs and Electric Fang Tattoo, plus a classic-car restoration side activity and a gang compound raid.

The Vintage Vice City Pack, included with any purchase before November 20, 2026. Guides list a '55 Vapid Stanier with its own garage, retro outfits and a weapon pattern. Digital pre-orders also get a free month of GTA+.

sources.name: PlayStation Blog - plays best on PS5

faq.q: Does the physical version come on a disc?
faq.a: No. Boxed copies contain a download code and go on sale November 12 so buyers can pre-load. Rockstar has announced no disc edition.

Not at launch: Take-Two describes the November 19 release as a single-player experience. A separate online mode is expected later, but Rockstar has not dated it. The 2027 talk comes from Twitch's CEO, not Rockstar.

sources.name: VGC - no disc at launch / single-player

faq.a: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, a criminal couple whose easy score goes wrong and pulls them into a conspiracy across Leonida. The Launch Trailer shows Jason as an Army veteran struggling for work and Lucia calling him from jail.

faq.q: Where and when is GTA 6 set?
faq.a: In present-day Leonida, Rockstar's take on Florida, centered on Vice City (Miami). Named regions include the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers (Everglades), Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.

faq.q: How big is the GTA 6 map?
faq.a: Rockstar's Aaron Garbut told Game Informer it is roughly twice the size of GTA V's and the studio's largest by some margin. No official square-mile figure exists.

faq.q: Can you switch between Jason and Lucia?
faq.a: Yes. You can swap freely in the open world, except during some story beats, and mid-chase one can drive while the other shoots. The partner you are not controlling keeps their own schedule and can be invited along.
Rockstar has not given an official length. Previews report that Rockstar North's Rob Nelson took about 80 hours to play through, in a chapter-based structure with choices.

faq.q: Does GTA 6 have a first-person mode?
faq.a: Not a full one at launch, per Rob Nelson. Aiming some weapons switches to a first-person view, and leaked dev-build clips of first-person driving are unconfirmed.
Console builds run at 30fps, per Rockstar North's Rob Nelson, and Digital Foundry measured a locked 30fps at about 1440p on base PS5. No 60fps mode has been announced, even for PS5 Pro.

faq.q: Is GTA 6 better on PS5 Pro?
faq.a: The PlayStation Store lists it as PS5 Pro Enhanced, but neither Sony nor Rockstar has said what the enhancement is. Expect image-quality gains rather than a confirmed higher frame rate.

faq.q: Will GTA 6 work on Xbox Series S?
faq.a: Yes, Series S is an official launch platform. Rockstar has shown no Series S footage, and resolution estimates around 720p are analyst predictions.

faq.q: How does the wanted system work?
faq.a: It goes up to six stars, and police respond only when a witness or camera reports a crime. Officers can identify your face, outfit or car, which you can shake with a full outfit change, a haircut, a discarded mask or a vehicle swap.

Shown or confirmed activities include gyms, fishing, scuba diving, kayaking, jet skis, airboats, street, off-road and motocross racing, base jumping, pool, mini golf, basketball, arcades, the zoo, nightclubs and strip clubs. Fighting rings and backyard wrestling also appear.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

faq.q: What radio stations are in GTA 6?
faq.a: Six are revealed so far: Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics. You can now listen on foot through earbuds, and on-demand podcasts are new to the series.

French electronic duo Justice composed the original score, their first game work. Their single 'Flower in a Hurricane' with Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard scores the Launch Trailer, and a soundtrack album arrives at launch.

faq.q: When do GTA 6 reviews come out?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said. Multiple reports point to the morning of November 18, with some outlets possibly held until launch, and review codes reportedly went out in late October.

Yes, twice. A 2022 hack exposed about 90 early-build clips, which Rockstar confirmed. From August 2026 a leaker called Cyberleek posted newer gameplay clips, and Rockstar called them heartbreaking and asked fans to wait for launch.

faq.q: Does GTA 6 have weather and hurricanes?
faq.a: Yes. A rebuilt weather system brings localized rain, lingering puddles, wind that reacts to buildings and time of day, and hurricanes and tropical storms. Rockstar has not said how often storms hit or whether they affect missions.

trailers.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 1
trailers.summary: The 1:31 reveal trailer introduced Lucia and a social-media-saturated Vice City and state of Leonida. It closed on a couple's convenience-store robbery and a 2025 release window for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar had scheduled it for Dec 5 but posted it on the evening of Dec 4 after it leaked.
trailers.records: Guinness: 90,421,491 YouTube views in 24 hours, the most-viewed video game trailer in 24h. It also took the most-liked video game trailer record (about 8.9M likes) and the most-viewed non-music YouTube video in 24h, beating MrBeast's 59.4M. YouTube's own blog counted 93M+ views in the first 24h, and the trailer had about 255M YouTube views by May 2025.

trailers.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2
trailers.summary: A 2:47 surprise drop four days after the first delay. Rockstar said it was captured on PS5 and is equal parts gameplay and cutscenes, centered on Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. At the time it carried the May 26, 2026 date, and it came alongside a large official website update with character bios.
trailers.records: Rockstar says it drew 475M+ views across all platforms in its first 24 hours and calls it the biggest video launch of all time. That figure is self-reported and multi-platform. It had about 84M YouTube views two days after release. Spotify reported a roughly 182,000% jump in streams of the featured song.

trailers.title: Grand Theft Auto VI cover art reveal video
trailers.summary: A short cover-art reveal video released alongside the price, editions and pre-order announcement (noted in the PlayStation Blog post that day).

trailers.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look Coming August 27
trailers.summary: A Rockstar teaser announcing that the first long-form gameplay presentation would premiere on Netflix on Aug 27 at 3 p.m. ET, then reach YouTube and the official site at 9 p.m. ET. Rockstar announced it on Aug 6.

trailers.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look
trailers.summary: This 26:48 presentation was Rockstar's first official extended gameplay showing, all in-game footage captured on a base PS5. It ran on Netflix first and on YouTube six hours later. It covered over-the-shoulder gunplay and cover, switching between Jason and Lucia, store and diner robberies, police pursuits, nightlife, scuba diving, fan boats and street racing.
trailers.records: Netflix counted 31.1M views for the week of Aug 24-30 (about 14M hours watched). It was Netflix's No. 1 English-language film that week and No. 1 in 87 of 93 tracked countries. Netflix defines a view as hours divided by runtime, so this is not comparable to YouTube counts.

trailers.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
trailers.summary: A roughly 90-second launch trailer captured on PS5, released 35 days before launch. It fills in Jason's backstory (trouble in the army, unable to get loans), then shows a phone call from Lucia, Lucia leaping from a speeding car onto a plane, heists, firefights and chases, ending on the pair jumping off a balcony hand in hand. It shows no new mechanics. The official page is https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/launch-trailer. The Rockstar YouTube upload ID could not be verified, and several fan or outlet re-uploads exist.
trailers.records: Rockstar has published no official view figure. A fan-account tally claimed about 119M cross-platform views in 24h (about 25.1M on YouTube), which is unverified.
