timeline.title: Rockstar confirms next GTA is in development
timeline.summary: In a GTA Online update post and on Twitter, Rockstar confirmed for the first time that the next Grand Theft Auto was in active development.

timeline.title: Rockstar confirms network intrusion and GTA VI footage leak
timeline.summary: A day after dozens of early development clips appeared online, Rockstar said an intruder had taken confidential data. It said work would continue as planned.

timeline.title: Sam Houser announces December trailer
timeline.summary: Rockstar president Sam Houser said the first trailer for the next GTA would arrive in December, timed to Rockstar's 25th anniversary.

timeline.title: Trailer 1 released early after leak
timeline.summary: After the trailer leaked, Rockstar posted it ahead of its planned Dec 5 debut. It revealed Vice City, Leonida, Lucia and a 2025 window for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

timeline.title: Trailer 1 sets Guinness and YouTube records
timeline.summary: Guinness certified 90.4M views in 24 hours plus two other records, and YouTube reported 93M+ first-day views.

timeline.title: Take-Two reiterates Fall 2025
timeline.summary: Take-Two's fiscal Q3 2025 release still listed GTA VI for Fall 2025. Zelnick called that a fairly narrow window.

timeline.title: Rockstar acquires Video Games Deluxe
timeline.summary: The Sydney studio behind L.A. Noire ports became Rockstar Australia.

timeline.title: First delay: Fall 2025 to May 26, 2026
timeline.summary: Rockstar moved the game into 2026. Take-Two backed the decision and kept its record-bookings outlook.

timeline.title: Trailer 2 surprise drop
timeline.summary: Trailer 2 focused on Jason and Lucia and was captured on PS5. Rockstar claimed 475M+ cross-platform views in 24 hours and expanded the official site.

timeline.title: Zelnick discusses first delay at FY25 earnings
timeline.summary: Zelnick declined to say when the delay was decided, conceded FY26 bookings would be lower, and said Take-Two's goal is to deliver more value than it charges.

timeline.title: Rockstar fires 34 staff in UK and Canada
timeline.summary: Rockstar dismissed 31 UK workers (all IWGB union members) and 3 in Canada for alleged gross misconduct over leaks. The union calls it union busting.

timeline.title: Second delay: May 26 to November 19, 2026
timeline.summary: Rockstar announced the new date on X, citing the need for more polish, the same day Take-Two reported fiscal Q2 2026 results.

timeline.title: 220 Rockstar North staff sign reinstatement letter
timeline.summary: Current Edinburgh staff asked management to reinstate the fired colleagues. Protests were planned at Take-Two and Rockstar offices.

timeline.title: UK Prime Minister calls firings concerning
timeline.summary: Keir Starmer told Parliament the allegations were deeply concerning and that ministers would look into the case.

timeline.title: Take-Two Q3 FY26: date holds, physical-delay rumor denied
timeline.summary: Take-Two reiterated Nov 19 and posted $1.76B in quarterly net bookings. Zelnick rejected a report that physical copies would be delayed and pointed to summer marketing.

timeline.title: Zelnick jokes about launch-day sick days at iicon
timeline.summary: At the ESA's new iicon event in Las Vegas, Zelnick predicted that many people will call in sick on Nov 19.

timeline.title: FY26 results: $8.0-8.2B FY27 guidance, no delay
timeline.summary: Take-Two guided record FY27 bookings driven by GTA VI. Zelnick said marketing starts around late June and dismissed Best Buy pre-order rumors.

timeline.title: Tribunal lets blacklisting claims proceed
timeline.summary: A UK employment tribunal refused Rockstar's bid to strike out the union's blacklisting claims ahead of the full hearing.

timeline.title: Price, editions and pre-orders announced
timeline.summary: Rockstar set $79.99 Standard and $99.99 Ultimate and called the game a single-player experience. Sony and Rockstar announced it plays best on PS5, and a cover-art video was released.

timeline.title: Pre-orders open worldwide
timeline.summary: Pre-orders went live at midnight local time with the Vintage Vice City Pack and a free GTA+ month for digital pre-orders.

timeline.title: Rockstar support: PS5 codes region-locked
timeline.summary: Rockstar's support FAQ says physical PS5 download codes only redeem in their sale region and that Japanese codes expire 170 days after launch. Xbox codes are not locked.

timeline.title: Netflix premiere of An Extended Look announced
timeline.summary: Rockstar set a Netflix-first premiere for Aug 27 at 3 p.m. ET, with YouTube to follow at 9 p.m. ET.

timeline.title: Q1 FY27: pre-orders called unprecedented
timeline.summary: Take-Two posted $1.39B in net bookings and held its $8.0-8.2B guidance. Zelnick called pre-order demand unprecedented but gave no figures.

timeline.title: Take-Two subpoenas Microsoft and Discord over leaks
timeline.summary: Take-Two filed in federal court in New York to unmask the 'Cyberleek' persona behind leaked gameplay clips.

timeline.title: Rockstar addresses gameplay leaks
timeline.summary: After a week of leaked clips, Rockstar called the leaks heartbreaking for its team, apologized for the long wait, and asked fans to hold on until launch.

timeline.title: An Extended Look premieres
timeline.summary: Rockstar's first official extended gameplay presentation (26:48, captured on PS5) premiered on Netflix and then YouTube. Press preview embargoes lifted the same day.

timeline.title: Report: console version runs at 30fps
timeline.summary: A creator who attended an Edinburgh demo said Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told guests the game runs at 30fps for now and would not promise a 60fps mode. Rockstar has not commented.

timeline.title: Take-Two seeks second Discord subpoena
timeline.summary: Take-Two called its leak investigation rapidly evolving, asked to file under seal, and withdrew a YouTube subpoena.

timeline.title: Extended Look tops Netflix with 31.1M views
timeline.summary: Netflix's weekly Top 10 put the special at No. 1 worldwide for Aug 24-30.

timeline.title: GTA VI DualSense controllers revealed at State of Play
timeline.summary: Sony revealed black (night) and white (day) limited-edition controllers at $84.99, with pre-orders from Sept 10 and release on Nov 19.

timeline.title: Union-busting tribunal opens in Glasgow
timeline.summary: The IWGB's case for 34 fired workers began, scheduled to run to mid-October.

timeline.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album announced
timeline.summary: Rockstar revealed a 34-track original album due Nov 19, with first singles from artists including Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen and Keith Richards.

timeline.title: 'Welcome to Vice City' sign goes up on Miami's Kaseya Center
timeline.summary: Crews installed giant pink rooftop letters on the Miami Heat's arena, visible to planes landing at Miami International.

timeline.title: $400 Vice City Collection collector's box
timeline.summary: Rockstar opened orders for an 11-item collector's box that does not include the game. It ships Nov 19.

timeline.title: Game Informer cover story
timeline.summary: A 14-page cover feature with Rockstar interviews and 12 new screenshots covered weather, wildlife and Florida research.

timeline.title: ESRB rates GTA VI Mature 17+
timeline.summary: The M rating with seven content descriptors and an in-game purchases notice appeared on PlayStation Store and Rockstar's site.

timeline.title: Radio stations revealed and Rockstar Store collection launches
timeline.summary: Rockstar named six in-game stations, including Flash FM and Dirty South Classics, and opened a GTA VI merch collection.

timeline.title: Take-Two sets Nov 9 earnings date; PC report surfaces
timeline.summary: Take-Two scheduled fiscal Q2 2027 results for Nov 9. Separately, GamesBeat reported, citing four insiders, a Q1 2027 PC release, which Rockstar has not confirmed.

timeline.title: Bloomberg Businessweek making-of feature
timeline.summary: Rockstar's Aaron Garbut and Phil Hooker discussed the 2022 leak and said the new engine and tools mean the next game won't take eight years.

timeline.title: Launch trailer and Justice score revealed
timeline.summary: Rockstar released a roughly 90-second launch trailer set to 'Flower in a Hurricane' and named Justice as the game's original score composers.

timeline.title: Tribunal hearing scheduled to end; no verdict reported
timeline.summary: The Glasgow hearing was due to close around Oct 15-16. No decision had been reported as of Oct 26.

timeline.title: Miami marketing blitz
timeline.summary: Vice City branding spread across Miami: a Goodyear blimp, beach umbrellas, buses, Wynwood Walls murals, a Dolphins game takeover and a Heat 'Night in Vice City' set for Nov 18.

timeline.title: Sensor Tower estimates 6.45M digital pre-orders
timeline.summary: A third-party estimate put digital pre-orders at about 6.45M copies (about $630M), roughly 74% on PlayStation. These are not official figures.

timeline.title: Xbox posts launch trailer eight days later
timeline.summary: Reports say the Xbox-branded launch trailer went up Oct 23, feeding talk of a Sony marketing deal.

timeline.title: Review codes reportedly sent; Nov 18 embargo rumored
timeline.summary: Leaker NateTheHate says outlets have received codes and that reviews go live Nov 18. Rockstar has not confirmed either.

timeline.title: Upcoming: Take-Two fiscal Q2 2027 earnings
timeline.summary: Results come after market close with a 4:30 p.m. ET call, the last scheduled investor update before launch.

timeline.title: Upcoming: preload and physical code-in-box release
timeline.summary: Digital pre-orders can begin downloading, and boxed codes go on sale to allow early downloads.

timeline.title: Upcoming: Grand Theft Auto VI launches
timeline.summary: Launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The album, collector's box and DualSense controllers also release that day.

timeline.title: Upcoming: Vintage Vice City Pack cutoff
timeline.summary: Purchases from this date on no longer include the pre-order bonus. Album vinyl begins shipping.

meta.title: The Vice City icon, reborn as the Ultimate prize
meta.why: It's the headline car of the Ultimate Edition, a retro wedge supercar that nods to the original Vice City's Cheetah, and a white one also shows up in trailer footage. Rockstar ties it to later-story action, so don't expect it on day one. No speed or handling stats exist yet; the top rank reflects its icon status and guaranteed access for Ultimate buyers.

sources.name: VGC - Ultimate Edition and pre-order bonuses

meta.title: The fastest-looking thing on Leonida's highways
meta.why: Trailer footage shows this hypercar tearing down a highway at night, and car spotters link its design to the Pininfarina Battista. Given its looks and the series' history it should sit near the top of the speed charts, but that is our inference: no stats or unlock method are known.

meta.title: The free classic that comes with a crime garage
meta.why: Anyone who buys before Nov 20 gets this two-tone 1950s sedan, kept at Shore Court Garage near Ocean Beach. The garage adds a weapon locker, a stolen-goods drop and a local fence, which makes it more useful early on than any single fast car. Expect a cruiser rather than a racer (our read of a '50s sedan).

sources.name: Game Developer - Rockstar pre-order press release

meta.title: A boat that doubles as an arms drop
meta.why: This pink-and-blue Ultimate Edition boat is docked at Washington Beach with an explosives-stocked weapons crate aboard. That makes it a floating resupply point as well as a way to work the coast. Its speed and handling haven't been shown.

sources.name: VGC - Ultimate Edition and pre-order bonuses

meta.title: Off-road brawler with its own hideout
meta.why: The Ultimate Edition's dune buggy is stored at the Paradise Garage in Watson Bay, which has a weapon locker and a drop point for stolen goods headed to a fence. A buggy looks made for Leonida's back-country trails, but its off-road performance is our inference until someone drives it.

sources.name: VGC - Ultimate Edition and pre-order bonuses

meta.title: The Extended Look's top-down cruiser
meta.why: Jason drives this red drop-top, which car spotters liken to a BMW E30, around Vice City with the roof down in the Extended Look. It's a style pick, not a speed pick: we know it's drivable, not how fast it is.

sources.name: Jalopnik - Cars in the GTA 6 Extended Look

meta.title: Army-green dirt bike waiting at Jason's place
meta.why: Ultimate Edition owners get this army-fatigue-styled motorcycle at Jason's safehouse, along with a Crest kayak. Motocross racing appears in the Extended Look, so a bike that's always parked at home should be handy for trails and quick escapes, though its performance numbers are unknown.

sources.name: VGC - Ultimate Edition and pre-order bonuses
The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

meta.title: Swamp transport with its own soundtrack
meta.why: Rockstar's music page pitches Back Country Radio as the soundtrack for airboat rides, and that station covers the Grassrivers wetlands and Port Gellhorn. Expect fan-driven swamp boats to be the natural way to cross that region, but their model names, speed and spawn spots aren't confirmed.

sources.name: Rockstar Games - The Music of GTA VI

meta.title: The cop-car eraser from Trailer 2
meta.why: Lucia fires one at police vehicles in Trailer 2, and weapon trackers say it resembles GTA V's launcher. Explosive splash damage makes it the strongest-looking answer to heavy pursuits, but ammo, unlock timing and damage values are unknown.

meta.title: The all-rounder rifle
meta.why: Jason is shown with an M16-style rifle in Extended Look material, and the carbine carries Duke Arms branding, a gunmaker carried over from Red Dead. Assault rifles are usually GTA's most versatile mid-range option, so we expect a workhorse; that comes from series history, not stats.

meta.title: The bank-job bullet hose
meta.why: Jason carries an MP5-style submachine gun with a red dot sight in Trailer 2's bank robbery. The optic hints at an attachment system, and a compact SMG suits indoor stick-ups and drive-and-shoot chases with your partner. Its real stats are unknown.

meta.title: His-and-hers hand cannons with a scope
meta.why: These Ultimate Edition revolvers have engraved, palm-etched grips and, per Rockstar's description, a high-performance scope. A scoped revolver should hit hard at range, but damage figures are unknown and you need the $99.99 edition to get them.

sources.name: VGC - Ultimate Edition and pre-order bonuses

meta.title: Close-quarters stopper with fast follow-ups
meta.why: A Benelli M4-style shotgun hangs on the wall of Phil's Ammu-Nation in Trailer 2. Semi-auto fire should beat the pump-action for clearing rooms during robberies, but that's inferred from the real-world design, not from any in-game numbers.

meta.title: Suppressive fire for six-star manhunts
meta.why: An M249-style LMG with a big box magazine sits on the Ammu-Nation rack in Trailer 2. With the wanted meter now going to six stars, a large magazine could matter when police pile on, though how Rockstar balances it is unknown.

meta.title: Jason's trusty sidearm
meta.why: Jason's Beretta-style pistol shows up throughout the trailers, and Ultimate Edition owners get an engraved version. Previews say you can wound limbs or shoot guns out of hands instead of killing, so an accurate starter sidearm may matter more than in past games; that last point is our inference.

sources.name: VGC - Ultimate Edition and pre-order bonuses

meta.title: Evidence burner, not a get-out-of-jail card
meta.why: In the Extended Look either lead can throw a Molotov to torch the getaway car. Burning an identified car looks like a way to shed it (our read), but TheGamer's recap notes the wanted level stayed after the car was destroyed, so pair it with a clean escape.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

meta.title: Don't go hunting for a 60fps toggle
meta.why: Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said console builds run at 30fps and would only check with the tech team about 60fps. Digital Foundry measured a very stable 30 on base PS5 and called a 60fps console mode extremely unlikely because the simulation is CPU-heavy. All analyzed gameplay so far is base PS5 capture, and Pure Xbox expects Series X to land in the same place.

sources.name: Pure Xbox - Digital Foundry Extended Look analysis

meta.title: Download a week early
meta.why: Digital pre-orders can start pre-loading on Nov 12, a week before the Nov 19 unlock, and code-in-box copies go on sale that day so physical buyers can pre-load too. Start the download as soon as it opens, especially on a slow connection.

sources.name: Game Developer - Rockstar pre-order press release

meta.title: Make room before pre-load day
meta.why: Rockstar hasn't published an install size, and the common 150-200GB figure is an outlet estimate, not an official number. GTA BOOM suggests freeing at least 250GB to cover a likely day-one patch, and notes the Xbox Series S has only about 364GB usable, so Series S owners may need an expansion card.

sources.name: GTA BOOM - Pre-load and storage guide

meta.title: Pro badge, but no promised frame-rate boost
meta.why: PlayStation's store page labels GTA VI as PS5 Pro Enhanced, yet neither Sony nor Rockstar has said what that changes. The Pro's main upgrades are its GPU and PSSR upscaling rather than its CPU, so outlets expect sharper, more stable images instead of 60fps; that is informed speculation.

meta.pick: DualSense haptics, adaptive triggers and Tempest 3D Audio
meta.title: Leave the PS5 extras switched on
meta.why: Sony and Rockstar list haptic feedback, adaptive trigger resistance, controller-speaker effects and Tempest 3D Audio for GTA VI on PS5. Rockstar hasn't said how each is tuned, so our suggestion is to start with them on, using headphones for 3D Audio, and switch off anything that gets tiring.

sources.name: PlayStation Blog - GTA VI plays best on PS5

meta.title: Calibrate HDR before you judge the colors
meta.why: Notebookcheck's write-up of Digital Foundry's launch-trailer analysis flags distorted hues during color shifts in the HDR footage, with one expert suspecting the tone mapping. Run your console's system HDR calibration first and compare HDR on and off on your TV, since Rockstar hasn't detailed GTA VI's in-game HDR or motion blur options.

meta.pick: Third-person camera (no full first-person at launch)
meta.title: Built for third person
meta.why: Rob Nelson told YouTuber Davy Jones there's no full first-person mode at launch because the team prioritized third-person animation. You can still aim some weapons in first person, so look for that rather than a full first-person toggle. FOV and other camera options haven't been detailed.

sources.name: VICE - Will GTA 6 have first-person mode

meta.title: No official accessibility list yet
meta.why: We found no Rockstar announcement of GTA VI accessibility options as of Oct 26, 2026. Older Rockstar Dundee job listings asked for accessibility audit experience and listed captioning and text-to-speech as plus skills, which hints at work under way but confirms nothing. Check the menus on day one.

meta.title: Lock in the Vintage Vice City Pack
meta.why: Every pre-order and every purchase made before Nov 20 adds the Vintage Vice City Pack: the '55 Stanier and its Shore Court garage, retro outfits for both leads, and a palm-print finish for most guns. Hypebeast reports physical pre-orders get it only while supplies last, so digital is the safe route.

sources.name: Game Developer - Rockstar pre-order press release

meta.title: The smartest way to buy
meta.why: Pre-ordering digitally on PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store adds a free month of GTA+ on top of the 7-day pre-load. On PlayStation the GTA+ month must be claimed by March 31, 2027, and it auto-renews at the paid rate unless you cancel.

sources.name: Game Developer - Rockstar pre-order press release

meta.title: Worth the extra $20 if you'll live in Leonida
meta.why: For $20 over Standard you get the '95 Cheetah, Dominator Buggy, Squalo boat and Dinka Enduro, the scoped Morgan revolvers, two extra mod shops, a salon, a tattoo parlor, a gang-compound raid and a classic-car commission for collector Wyman. Rockstar ties the extras to the story, and Take-Two's CEO says pre-orders skew toward this edition. Whether it's worth it is our judgment, not a measured value.

sources.name: VGC - Ultimate Edition and pre-order bonuses

meta.title: The budget path keeps your options open
meta.why: Standard includes the base game plus the same pre-order perks, and PlayStation lists an Ultimate Edition Upgrade add-on, currently marked unavailable. Hypebeast reports Standard owners can buy the upgrade later, so you can wait for reviews before deciding on the extras; the upgrade's price hasn't been listed.

meta.title: Boxed copies have no disc
meta.why: Rockstar confirmed retail boxes contain a download code, not a disc, and its press release says they go on sale Nov 12 to support pre-loading. Notebookcheck reports the Ultimate Edition isn't sold in retail cases, so in our view a box mainly makes sense for gifting or using store credit.

sources.name: Game Developer - Rockstar pre-order press release
VGC - No disc version at launch

meta.pick: Robberies: crack the safe or blow it
meta.title: Greed vs. speed on every job
meta.why: Previews describe a trade-off: blowing a safe is fast but can damage the loot, while finding the combination keeps the full haul and gives police time to surround the building. Recaps also show a notice under the wanted stars when you enter a shop saying whether it has cameras, so check it and find the back exits before you start.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

meta.pick: Shake the cops by changing your description
meta.title: New outfit, new face, new car
meta.why: Police only know what witnesses and cameras report, and icons under the wanted meter show whether they have your face, outfit or car. A full outfit change works where a hat or glasses won't, a barber can clear your description, and a mask dumped after the job hides your face. Torching the getaway car isn't enough by itself: one recap notes the wanted level stuck around.

meta.pick: Scan before you steal with WAINK
meta.title: Know the car before you touch it
meta.why: The WAINK phone app shows a parked car's value, registration cost, locks, alarm and tracker. Older cars open with a slim jim, newer luxury models need gear like key cloners, and GPS-tracked cars report to police, so skip trackers early or be ready to ditch the car fast.

sources.name: Jalopnik - Cars in the GTA 6 Extended Look

meta.title: Fences pay for clean paint
meta.why: Stolen cars and jewelry go through specialist fences, and visibly damaged cars fetch less. Vice City's narrow, busy streets make clean deliveries harder, so drive gently on the way in; vehicle fences may also tip you off to valuable targets such as cars in impound lots.

meta.title: Two criminals, one getaway
meta.why: You can swap between Jason and Lucia in free roam, trade the wheel for the gun in a shared car, and split up so police have to divide their attention. The partner you aren't playing keeps their own schedule and texts you, and previews say ignoring them too often can hurt the relationship.

sources.name: The Big Lead - Extended Look recap

meta.title: Cash matters more this time
meta.why: Previews say money is more important than in past GTAs, and some story sections may require a set amount of cash to move forward. Car fencing, stick-ups, store robberies and bank jobs are the known earners, so hold off on splurging until you know what the story will ask for.

meta.pick: Stash gear in trunks and bonus garages
meta.title: Your car is a mobile locker
meta.why: Vehicle trunks hold spare weapons and a change of clothes, which pairs neatly with the outfit-swap escape trick. Early buyers also get Shore Court Garage with a weapon locker and stolen-goods drop, and Ultimate owners add the Paradise Garage.

meta.title: Storms are local, so you can drive out of them
meta.why: Rockstar told Game Informer that rain can fall in one spot while the next area stays sunny, that wet surfaces linger after a storm passes, and that tropical storms and hurricanes are in the game. How weather affects driving or missions hasn't been explained, so driving out of a downpour is our suggestion, not a confirmed mechanic.

sources.name: Game Informer - Tropical storms and hurricanes

meta.title: Bad Bunny's Latin party station
meta.why: Modern Latin music, from bachata and merengue to dembow and reggaeton, hosted by El Martillo (Bad Bunny) and La Gata (RaiNao). Rockstar sells it as a nonstop party, which fits Vice City nightlife. The top rank reflects host star power and fit with the city, not listening data.

meta.why: Rockstar bills this pop station as a Vice City institution, hosted by Robyn and Alex Consani. The name echoes the original Vice City's pop station, making it the nostalgia pick for neon night drives.

meta.title: Trick Daddy and Trina run the South

Consequence - GTA 6 radio stations and hosts

meta.title: Slayer legends host the metal station
meta.why: Heavy metal from the 1980s onward, hosted by DJ Kerry (Kerry King) and DJ Tom (Tom Araya) of Slayer. Our pick for high-star police chases.

sources.name: Consequence - GTA 6 radio stations and hosts

meta.title: Burna Boy's amapiano and Afro classics
meta.why: African music from 20th-century classics to amapiano and 3-step, hosted by Burna (Burna Boy) and Palmsy (Palms Trax). It's the left-field pick for late-night cruising.

sources.name: Rockstar Games - The Music of GTA VI
Consequence - GTA 6 radio stations and hosts

meta.pick: Radio on foot and on-demand podcasts
meta.title: Your soundtrack follows you out of the car
meta.why: For the first time, stations and podcasts play through your character's phone and earbuds while you walk, and podcasts are on-demand so you choose the episode. Rockstar calls it the series' broadest radio and podcast lineup yet, spanning classic rock to talk radio.

sources.name: Rockstar Games - The Music of GTA VI

meta.title: More stations are coming, names unconfirmed
meta.why: Rockstar has revealed only six stations and hasn't said whether the rest will be shown before launch. Kotaku's leak tracker lists names like V-Rock, Emotion 98.3, Vice City FM and Kaleidoscope FM, but none are confirmed and leaked material may not match the final game.
